name: Book of Combos 1
desc:
An introductory text for first-
time combiners. Improves your
combination success rate.

name: Book of Combos 2
desc:
An entry-level text. Owning
Book 1 and this improves your
combination success rate.

name: Book of Combos 3
desc:
An intermediate text. Owning
Books 1, 2, and this improves
your combination success rate.

name: Book of Combos 4
desc:
An advanced text. Owning
Books 1-3 and this improves
your combination success rate.

name: Book of Combos 5
desc:
A pro-level text. Owning
Books 1-4 and this improves
your combination success rate.

name: Organizer Guide
desc:
An issue of "Hunting Life"
magazine which tells how to
maximize Item/Palico Boxes.

name: Pack Rat Guide
desc:
An issue of "Hunting Life"
magazine containing advanced
item-cramming techniques.

name: Binoculars
desc:
Allow you to see farther
and observe from a distance.

name: Potion
desc:
Restores a small amount of
Health.

name: Mega Potion
desc:
Restores a moderate amount
of Health.

name: Nutrients
desc:
Very slightly increases your
maximum Health level.

name: Mega Nutrients
desc:
Slightly increases your
maximum Health level.

name: Antidote
desc:
Removes all traces of poison
from your system.

name: Immunizer
desc:
Boosts your natural ability
to heal.

name: Dash Juice
desc:
Lets you run without tiring
for a short period of time.

name: Mega Dash Juice
desc:
Lets you run without tiring
for longer than regular
Dash Juice does.

name: Demondrug
desc:
Boosts your Attack by filling
you with -- guess what? --
demonic strength.

name: Mega Demondrug
desc:
Boosts your Attack even more
than a regular Demondrug.

name: Might Pill
desc:
Temporarily endows you with
the strength of a mighty god.
Potent!

name: Armorskin
desc:
Boosts your Defense by turning
your skin as hard as rock.

name: Mega Armorskin
desc:
Boosts your Defense even more
than a regular Armorskin.

name: Adamant Pill
desc:
Temporarily makes your skin
as hard as adamant. Potent!

name: Cool Drink
desc:
Provides temporary relief
from extreme heat.

name: Hot Drink
desc:
Provides temporary relief
from extreme cold.

name: Cleanser
desc:
Immediately removes any ice
or webbing on your body.
Clean as a whistle!

name: Psychoserum
desc:
Temporarily sharpens your
sixth sense and attunes you
to the ways of monsters.

name: Herbal Medicine
desc:
Removes all traces of poison
and restores a slight amount
of Health.

name: Max Potion
desc:
Fully restores Health and
maximizes the size of your
Health Gauge.

name: Ancient Potion
desc:
Fully restores Health and
maximizes the size of your
Health and Stamina Gauges.

name: Energy Drink
desc:
A Guild-approved beverage
that boosts your Stamina.
Helps shake off sleep, too!

name: Lifepowder
desc:
Medicine made from compounded
Lifecrystals. Heals those within
range with a single touch.

name: Dust of Life
desc:
A medicine with strong curative
properties. Studied in secret,
it is said to restore youth.

name: Hunter's Drink
desc:
A beverage that temporarily
makes it easier to fill the
Hunter Arts Gauge.

name: Catalyst
desc:
Works with other materials
to enhance their effects.
Cannot be used by itself.

name: Gunpowder
desc:
A dangerous substance that
explodes when struck or heated.

name: Lifecrystals
desc:
Mysterious crystals long
worshipped as a source of life.

name: Tranquilizer
desc:
Medicine that works as an
anesthetic when combined.

name: Yukumo Egg
desc:
A popular dish from Yukumo
Village. Known for its rich yolk
and how it melts in the mouth.

name: Tanzia Chips
desc:
A nutritious snack made with
ingredients caught in Tanzian
waters. Tastes like seafood.

name: Powercharm
desc:
An amulet that raises Attack.
Just carrying this gives you
demonic strength.

name: Powertalon
desc:
A powerful amulet that
raises Attack. Made with
a Deviljho Talon.

name: Armorcharm
desc:
An amulet that raises Defense.
Just carrying this hardens
your skin like stone.

name: Armortalon
desc:
A powerful amulet that
raises Defense. Made with
a Deviljho Talon.

name: BBQ Spit
desc:
Just what you need to cook
meat. A must-have item for
any hungry hunter.

name: Raw Meat
desc:
Meat carved from a monster.
Can be cooked, combined, or
used to set a trap.

name: Poisoned Meat
desc:
Raw Meat that poisons
whatever eats it. Makes
great bait for traps.

name: Tinged Meat
desc:
Raw Meat that paralyzes
whatever eats it. Makes
great bait for traps.

name: Drugged Meat
desc:
Raw Meat that puts whatever
eats it to sleep. Makes
great bait for traps.

name: Rare Steak
desc:
Provides a small boost to
your Stamina. This one's
still red in the middle.

name: Well-done Steak
desc:
Provides a moderate boost
to your Stamina. Meat done
right!

name: Burnt Meat
desc:
Meat that has been burnt to
a crisp. It might boost your
Stamina, or it might drain it...

name: Chilled Meat
desc:
Meat that cools the body,
wards off heat, and restores
a moderate amount of Stamina.

name: Hot Meat
desc:
Meat that warms the body,
wards off the cold, and restores
a moderate amount of Stamina.

name: Mosswine Jerky
desc:
Dried Mosswine meat. The more
you chew it, the more flavorful
and juicy it becomes.

name: Kingmeat
desc:
Like its name implies, it's the
King of Meats. Doesn't get
any juicier than this!

name: Whetstone
desc:
A standard-sized Whetstone.
Use it to restore a weapon's
Sharpness.

name: Old Pickaxe
desc:
A cheap pickaxe with an
easily nicked blade.

name: Iron Pickaxe
desc:
A pickaxe with a reasonably
strong blade.

name: Mega Pickaxe
desc:
A pickaxe tempered with steel.
This one won't nick easily.

name: Old Bug Net
desc:
A cheap net for catching bugs.
It tears easily.

name: Bug Net
desc: A durable net for catching bugs.

name: Mega Bug Net
desc:
An extremely durable net
for catching bugs. This one
is made to last.

name: Boomerang
desc:
An unusually-shaped weapon
from abroad that returns to
its user when thrown.

name: Throwing Knife
desc:
A standard throwing knife.
Flies straight and true.
<COL FFFF50FF>(Supply Item)</COL>

name: Poison Knife
desc:
A throwing knife with a venom-
coated blade. Poisons targets.
<COL FFFF50FF>(Supply Item)</COL>

name: Sleep Knife
desc:
A throwing knife that has been
dusted with sleeping agents.
<COL FFFF50FF>(Supply Item)</COL>

name: Paralysis Knife
desc:
A throwing knife coated with
toxins that paralyze a target.
<COL FFFF50FF>(Supply Item)</COL>

name: Tranq Knife
desc:
A throwing knife used to capture
monsters ensnared in traps.
<COL FFFF50FF>(Supply Item)</COL>

name: Bomb Casing
desc:
A base material for making
hand-thrown bombs.

name: Paintball
desc:
Toss this scented paint at a
monster to mark it, allowing
you to track its position.

name: Flash Bomb
desc:
Flashes brightly on impact.
Toss this right under a
monster's nose to blind it.

name: Sonic Bomb
desc:
A grenade-like item that
emits a high-frequency blast
of sound on detonation.

name: Tranq Bomb
desc:
A hand grenade used to capture
monsters ensnared in traps. Can
be slammed against the ground.

name: Deodorant
desc:
An item that cures Stench.
Releases a puff of deodorizing
smoke when thrown down.

name: Smoke Bomb
desc:
Creates a large cloud of
smoke wherever it lands.

name: Poison Smoke Bomb
desc:
Contains a toxic chemical.
Also popular as a household
bug bomb.

name: Farcaster
desc:
Instantly transports you
back to base camp.

name: Dung Bomb
desc:
When thrown, releases a strong
odor which certain monsters
find repulsive.

name: Dung
desc:
That's right: monster poop.
The odor reveals (too) much
about the monster's diet.

name: Trap Tool
desc:
A must-have item for putting
together Pitfall Traps and
other kinds of traps.

name: Spider Web
desc: A very sticky web.

name: Net
desc:
A sturdy net able to support
a certain amount of weight
without breaking.

name: Pitfall Trap
desc:
A trap for catching certain
large monsters. It is
tripped by a heavy weight.

name: Shock Trap
desc:
A trap that immobilizes a target.
Use it to capture monsters.

name: Barrel Lid
desc:
A small barrel lid.
There appears to be a
drawing on it.

name: Small Barrel
desc: A small, empty barrel.

name: Large Barrel
desc: A large, empty barrel.

name: Barrel Bomb S
desc: A small time bomb.

name: Barrel Bomb L
desc:
A powerful bomb triggered
by external physical
impact.

name: Barrel Bomb L+
desc:
Upgraded Large Barrel
Bomb. Effective against
large monsters.

name: Bounce Bomb
desc:
Launches into the air when
set. This modified bomb
requires skill to use.

name: Bounce Bomb+
desc:
An improved version of the
Bounce Bomb. Requires some
skill to use.

name: Affinity Oil
desc:
A red oil for the Sword &
Shield. Once applied, it
greatly increases Affinity.

name: Destroyer Oil
desc:
A green oil for the Sword
and Shield. Makes it easier
to stagger your target.

name: Stamina Oil
desc:
A blue oil for the Sword &
Shield. Once applied, it will
drain monsters' stamina.

name: Mind's Eye Oil
desc:
A white oil for the Sword &
Shield. Once applied, your
attacks cannot be deflected.

name: Huskberry
desc:
A berry that is hollow on
the inside. Tough enough to
grow just about anywhere.

name: Bone Husk
desc:
Used as a bone ammo casing.
Produces sturdier results
than a Huskberry.

name: Normal S Lv1
desc:
Ammo for novices. Cheap,
but don't expect much.
Unlimited shots.

name: Normal S Lv2
desc:
Non-specialized ammo.
More powerful than Lv1.
Capacity: 99

name: Normal S Lv3
desc:
Non-specialized ammo that
ricochets, resulting in high
damage. Capacity: 99

name: Pierce S Lv1
desc:
Armor-piercing ammo that deals
multiple hits to some monsters.
Capacity: 60

name: Pierce S Lv2
desc:
High-grade armor-piercing ammo.
Deals more hits than Lv1.
Capacity: 60

name: Pierce S Lv3
desc:
Max-grade armor-piercing ammo.
Deals numerous hits.
Capacity: 60

name: Pellet S Lv1
desc:
Ammo that covers a wide area.
Deals multiple hits at close
range. Capacity: 80

name: Pellet S Lv2
desc:
High-grade ammo that covers
a wide area. Deals more hits
than Lv1. Capacity: 70

name: Pellet S Lv3
desc:
Max-grade ammo that covers
a wide area. Deals numerous
hits. Capacity: 60

name: Crag S Lv1
desc:
Powerful ammo that lodges
in a target and explodes.
Also stuns. Capacity: 9

name: Crag S Lv2
desc:
Very powerful ammo that lodges
in a target and explodes.
Also stuns. Capacity: 9

name: Crag S Lv3
desc:
Extremely powerful ammo that
lodges in a target and explodes.
Also stuns. Capacity: 9

name: Clust S Lv1
desc:
Ammo that fragments into three
shells upon impact. Beware of
friendly fire! Capacity: 3

name: Clust S Lv2
desc:
Ammo that fragments into four
shells upon impact. Beware of
friendly fire! Capacity: 3

name: Clust S Lv3
desc:
Ammo that fragments into five
shells upon impact. Beware of
friendly fire! Capacity: 3

name: Flaming S Lv1
desc:
Ammo that packs extra punch
against monsters susceptible
to Fire. Capacity: 60

name: Water S Lv1
desc:
Ammo that packs extra punch
against monsters susceptible
to Water. Capacity: 60

name: Thunder S Lv1
desc:
Ammo that packs extra punch
against monsters susceptible
to Thunder. Capacity: 60

name: Freeze S Lv1
desc:
Ammo that packs extra punch
against monsters susceptible
to Ice. Capacity: 60

name: Dragon S Lv1
desc:
Mysterious ammo that won't
work in regular Bowguns.
Capacity: 3

name: Poison S Lv1
desc:
Poisons target, but may
require several shots.
Capacity: 12

name: Poison S Lv2
desc:
Enhanced ammo that inflicts
Poison. Some targets require
multiple shots. Capacity: 12

name: Para S Lv1
desc:
Ammo that causes Paralysis.
Some targets require
multiple shots. Capacity: 12

name: Para S Lv2
desc:
Enhanced ammo that causes
Paralysis. Some targets require
multiple shots. Capacity: 8

name: Sleep S Lv1
desc:
Ammo that induces Sleep.
Some targets require
multiple shots. Capacity: 12

name: Sleep S Lv2
desc:
Enhanced ammo that induces
Sleep. Some targets require
multiple shots. Capacity: 8

name: Exhaust S Lv1
desc:
Special ammo that drains
monsters' stamina.
Capacity: 12

name: Exhaust S Lv2
desc:
Enhanced special ammo that
drains monsters' stamina.
Capacity: 8

name: Recover S Lv1
desc:
Ammo that restores a small
amount of Health to an ally
upon impact. Capacity: 12

name: Recover S Lv2
desc:
Ammo that restores a moderate
amount of Health to an ally
upon impact. Capacity: 12

name: Paint S
desc:
Ammo that marks a monster's
position on your Map for a
limited time. Capacity: 99

name: Tranq S
desc:
Bowgun ammo used to capture
monsters ensnared in traps.
Capacity: 8

name: Empty Phial
desc:
A regular old empty phial.
Nothing more, nothing less.

name: Power Coating Lv1
desc:
An arrow coating that increases
the Attack of arrows.
Capacity: 50

name: Power Coating Lv2
desc:
An arrow coating that greatly
increases the Attack of
arrows. Capacity: 50

name: Elem Coating Lv1
desc:
An arrow coating that increases
the elemental damage of arrows.
Capacity: 20

name: Elem Coating Lv2
desc:
An arrow coating that greatly
increases the elemental damage
of arrows. Capacity: 20

name: C.Range Coating
desc:
An arrow coating that increases
close-range power and melee
Sharpness. Capacity: 20

name: Poison Coating
desc:
An arrow coating that applies
Poison effects to arrows.
Capacity: 20

name: Para Coating
desc:
An arrow coating that applies
Paralysis effects to arrows.
Capacity: 20

name: Sleep Coating
desc:
An arrow coating that applies
Sleep effects to arrows.
Capacity: 20

name: Exhaust Coating
desc:
An arrow coating that causes
arrows to drain monsters'
stamina. Capacity: 20

name: Blast Coating
desc:
An arrow coating that applies
explosive powder to arrows.
Capacity: 20

name: Paint Coating
desc:
An arrow coating that marks a
monster's position on the Map
for a limited time. Capacity: 99

name: Larval Extract
desc:
Highly aromatic, combine with
Jelly or Ambrosia to create
wholesome food for Kinsects.

name: Paralarval Extract
desc:
Highly fragrant, combine with
Jelly or Ambrosia to make
nutritious food for Kinsects.

name: Power Jelly
desc:
Tree sap loved by Kinsects.
Perfect for growing strong
and healthy Kinsects!

name: Heavy Jelly
desc:
Tree sap loved by Kinsects.
Perfect for aiding robust
Kinsect development!

name: Speed Jelly
desc:
Tree sap loved by Kinsects.
Perfect for aiding rapid
Kinsect development!

name: Fire Ambrosia
desc:
A sweet nectar loved by
Kinsects; increases their
Fire Element strength.

name: Water Ambrosia
desc:
A sweet nectar loved by
Kinsects; increases their
Water Element strength.

name: Thunder Ambrosia
desc:
A sweet nectar loved by
Kinsects; increases their
Thunder Element strength.

name: Ice Ambrosia
desc:
A sweet nectar loved by
Kinsects; increases their
Ice Element strength.

name: Dragon Ambrosia
desc:
A sweet nectar loved by
Kinsects; increases their
Dragon Element strength.

name: Power Jelly+
desc:
Thick tree sap loved by
Kinsects. Perfect for growing
strong and healthy Kinsects!

name: Heavy Jelly+
desc:
Thick tree sap loved by
Kinsects. Perfect for aiding
robust Kinsect development!

name: Speed Jelly+
desc:
Thick tree sap loved by
Kinsects. Perfect for aiding
rapid Kinsect development!

name: Power Jelly++
desc:
Very thick tree sap loved by
Kinsects. Perfect for growing
strong and healthy Kinsects!

name: Heavy Jelly++
desc:
Very thick tree sap loved by
Kinsects. Perfect for aiding
robust Kinsect development!

name: Speed Jelly++
desc:
Very thick tree sap loved by
Kinsects. Perfect for aiding
rapid Kinsect development!

name: Fire Ambrosia+
desc:
A sweet nectar loved by
Kinsects; greatly increases
Fire Element strength.

name: Water Ambrosia+
desc:
A sweet nectar loved by
Kinsects; greatly increases
Water Element strength.

name: Thunder Ambrosia+
desc:
A sweet nectar loved by
Kinsects; greatly increases
Thunder Element strength.

name: Ice Ambrosia+
desc:
A sweet nectar loved by
Kinsects; greatly increases
Ice Element strength.

name: Dragon Ambrosia+
desc:
A sweet nectar loved by
Kinsects; greatly increases
Dragon Element strength.

name: Douse Ambrosia
desc:
A sour nectar that reduces
Fire Element strength and
increases Dragon.

name: Drought Ambrosia
desc:
A sour nectar that reduces
Water Element strength and
increases Fire.

name: Resistor Ambrosia
desc:
A sour nectar that reduces
Thunder Element strength
and increases Water.

name: Melt Ambrosia
desc:
A sour nectar that reduces
Ice Element strength and
increases Thunder.

name: De-wyrm Ambrosia
desc:
A sour nectar that reduces
Dragon Element strength
and increases Ice.

name: Reverse Ambrosia
desc:
A nectar made by a Kinsect
breeder; causes them to lose
all of their Element strengths.

name: Alchemy Barrel
desc:
A hunting tool used by Alchemy
Style Hunters. You can shake it
to create new items.

name: Alchemy Food
desc:
Eat to restore some Stamina.
It goes down a treat, but does
leave you a bit thirsty.

name: Alchemy Immunizer
desc:
Eat this and your Health will
gradually restore for a short
time. It even smells healthy!

name: Alchemy Earplugs
desc:
These earplugs protect your
delicate ears from loud monster
roars...once. Talk about fragile.

name: Alchemy Slick
desc:
Crystallized Alchemy Barrel
contents. Why not try combining
it with other Alchemy Items?

name: Alchemy Cheer
desc:
Fills up some of your (and
nearby allies') Arts Gauge
and/or Support Gauge.

name: Alchemy Whetstone
desc:
Use this to restore your weapon's
Sharpness and have your Arts
Gauge fill faster for a while.

name: Alchemy Bullet
desc:
Alchemy-created ammo that fills
your Arts Gauge faster (when it
hits, that is). Capacity: 30

name: Alchemy Coating
desc:
Works with any Bow, and fills up
your Arts Gauge a bit quicker.
Capacity: 20

name: Alchemy Sonic Bomb
desc:
Launches a bird-like puppet that
emits a screech that small
monsters can't stand.

name: Alchemy Booster
desc:
This liquid of purest Alchemy
allows your Alchemy Gauge to
fill more quickly for a while.

name: Alchemy Fireball
desc:
This fireball blasts out of your
Alchemy Barrel and explodes
on impact.

name: Alchemy Remedy
desc:
Restores some Health and
removes status afflictions from
you and nearby allies.

name: Worm
desc:
A fishing lure. Wriggles
underwater, enticing those
fishies to bite.

name: Mega Fishing Fly
desc:
A fly lure that causes a
feeding frenzy no matter
what fish is biting.

name: Frog
desc:
A fishing lure. The ideal bait
for certain aquatic monsters.

name: Sushifish Bait
desc:
A nugget-shaped fishing
lure that makes Sushifish
go "mmm."

name: Burst Bait
desc:
A fishing lure with chum that
makes fish that rupture upon
death go "mmm."

name: Goldenfish Bait
desc:
A nugget-shaped fishing lure
that makes Goldenfish and
Brocadefish go "mmm."

name: Field Horn
desc:
Used to attract certain
monsters -- blow at your own
risk. May break when used.

name: Health Flute
desc:
Restores Health to those who
hear it. May break when used.

name: Antidote Flute
desc:
Eliminates poison in the
blood of those who hear it.
May break when used.

name: Demon Flute
desc:
Increases the strength of
those who hear it. May
break when used.

name: Armor Flute
desc:
Bolsters the defenses of
those who hear it. May
break when used.

name: Garbage
desc:
Junk created when a
combination attempt fails.

name: Honey
desc:
Sweet, golden honey. High in
nutritional value.

name: Herb
desc:
Restores a very small amount
of Health. Not very flavorful.

name: Antidote Herb
desc:
A plant used in antidotes.
It sometimes cures poison
when eaten by itself.

name: Fire Herb
desc: A wondrous, flammable plant.

name: Ivy
desc:
A lightweight and
extremely strong plant.

name: Sleep Herb
desc:
A plant containing sleeping
agents.

name: Sap Plant
desc:
A plant with leaves coated
in sticky sap. Difficult
to remove once attached.

name: Felvine
desc:
Melynxes' favorite food --
they just have to steal it.

name: Gloamgrass Root
desc:
Possesses antidotal agents,
but it will not work by itself.

name: Hot Pepper
desc:
Blazingly spicy. Sure, it'll
warm you up, but it's too
hot to handle on its own.

name: Snow Herb
desc:
A radiant plant admired for
the lovely white patterns on
its leaves. It's as cold as ice.

name: Spicy Mushroom
desc:
A mushroom with bite
that recovers a small
amount of Stamina.

name: Frozen Berry
desc:
A completely frozen berry.
Can provide relief from
heat and recover Stamina.

name: King Cactus
desc:
The ultimate cactus plant,
just touching its spines can
put you in a world of hurt.

name: Dosbiscus
desc:
A large, beautifully
colored flowering plant
foreign to this land.

name: Heftcorn
desc:
Gigantic corn that's difficult
to cultivate in this region.
It's packed with kernels.

name: Stargazer Flower
desc:
A plant that looks to the
heavens when it blooms. Its
petals are used to make dye.

name: Prismatic Dandelion
desc:
A pretty dandelion with
petals of various colors.
It's used for making dyes.

name: Immaculate Ore
desc:
This piece of ore is small but
somehow perfect. Used for
forging and upgrading armor.

name: Dragonvine
desc:
Legend says that wherever an
ancient dragon stepped, this vine
grew. Used to make armor.

name: Tough Dragonvine
desc:
This high quality vine is said to
grow where ancient dragons
slept. Used to make armor.

name: Blue Mushroom
desc:
Rare mushroom with a
power-enhancing effect.

name: Nitroshroom
desc:
A hard-to-find mushroom
with the power to generate
blazing heat.

name: Parashroom
desc:
A mushroom that induces
paralysis.

name: Toadstool
desc:
Logic says not to eat this
poisonous fungus, but don't
write it off completely.

name: Mopeshroom
desc:
A mushroom that contains a
Stamina-stealing constituent.

name: Exciteshroom
desc:
This one has a very strange
aroma... But is it edible?
Only one way to find out.

name: Dragon Toadstool
desc:
A dangerous fungus
said to draw the life
out of people. Beware.

name: Chaos Mushroom
desc:
A mushroom that invites
disarray. Its spores cause
monsters to hallucinate.

name: Bindshroom
desc:
A giant paralyzing mushroom.
Just one touch can immobilize
you, so handle with care!

name: Reststool
desc:
A large, poisonous mushroom.
It looks like a comfy chair,
but it's not worth the risk.

name: Paintberry
desc:
A berry with a shocking hue
and an overwhelming scent.
Look out: it WILL stain!

name: Might Seed
desc:
Temporarily raises your
Attack when ingested by
improving energy flow.

name: Adamant Seed
desc:
Temporarily raises your
Defense when ingested by
hardening tissue.

name: Nulberry
desc:
A mysterious berry that cures
various Blights and also
protects from unknown viruses.

name: Dragonfell Berry
desc:
A mysterious berry, rumored
since ancient times to be
loathed by dragons.

name: Scatternut
desc:
A nut that violently ejects
its contents when struck.

name: Needleberry
desc:
A berry covered with needle-
like thorns. Used as a
material for ammo.

name: Latchberry
desc:
A berry with spiral grooves.
It spins when it falls to
firmly embed itself in soil.

name: Bomberry
desc:
A berry that explodes when
struck.

name: Bumblepumpkin
desc:
A trendy orange pumpkin.
If left undisturbed, it can grow
to gigantic proportions.

name: Giant Acorn
desc:
An extremely large and firm
acorn. The tree that it grows
from is said to be gigantic.

name: Spiky Acorn
desc:
An acorn with a very sharp
tip. It's especially hard
before it turns ripe.

name: Yukumo Wood
desc:
A hearty tree that grows
near Yukumo Village. It's
pliable and easy to craft.

name: Yukumo Hardwood
desc:
A tree of high quality that
grows near Yukumo Village.
It's widely used as lumber.

name: Yukumo Stoutwood
desc:
A sturdy tree that grows near
Yukumo Village. It's so rare, you
can't buy the wood anywhere.

name: Stone
desc:
A small rock.
Can be thrown.

name: Iron Ore
desc:
Ore that can be smelted
into metal and used for
many different purposes.

name: Earth Crystal
desc:
Crystallized microbes which
are prized as an abrasive
when forging weapons.

name: Machalite Ore
desc:
An ore that yields better
metals than Iron Ore.
Used to make Machalite.

name: Disc Stone
desc:
A disc-shaped stone.
Not recommended to
throw at your friends.

name: Ice Crystal
desc:
Ice that will not melt at
room temperature. Can be
used to create denser ore.

name: Bealite Ore
desc:
An ore that contains high
amounts of gold. Can be used
to create stronger metals.

name: Lightcrystal
desc:
An extremely hard substance
with a faint glow. Sometimes
used for crafting tools.

name: Dragonite Ore
desc:
An ore that yields metal
superior to that of Machalite.
Rare and valuable.

name: Firestone
desc:
Combusts even at room
temperature. Its high heat can
be used to fuse materials.

name: Allfire Stone
desc:
An ore that blazes with an
all-consuming flame. Requires
considerable skill to mine.

name: Lava Nugget
desc:
Melted rock stripped from the
body of an Uragaan or Agnaktor.
Various ores are mixed within.

name: Carbalite Ore
desc:
An ore still being researched.
It yields even better metal
than Dragonite.

name: Eltalite Ore
desc:
A promising new ore that
produces higher quality
metal than Carbalite Ore.

name: Meldspar Ore
desc:
An ore composed of a durable,
flexible metal that works well
as a combining agent.

name: Novacrystal
desc:
A brightly glowing crystal.
Extremely hard, it's also
used to make armory tools.

name: Purecrystal
desc:
A crystal that's 100% pure.
Hard enough to be used in
workshop tools.

name: Fucium Ore
desc:
Ore composed of a mysterious
metal; capable of fusing nearly
any two materials together.

name: Firecell Stone
desc:
A magma-like deposit that
only trained hands can
properly work with.

name: Rainbow Ore
desc:
A beautiful multi-colored
ore. Colors and properties
depend on many variables.

name: Pristine Ore
desc:
An exquisite ore sure to elicit a
gasp from veteran smiths. Used
for forging and upgrading armor.

name: Ultimas Crystal
desc:
A crystal used to reinforce metal.
It improves both durability and
shock absorbency.

name: Aquaglow Jewel
desc:
An indispensable item used
in Decorations.

name: Sunspire Jewel
desc:
An indispensable item used
in Decorations.

name: Bloodrun Jewel
desc:
An indispensable item used
in Decorations. A shame that
these are so high-end.

name: Lazurite Jewel
desc:
An indispensable item used
in Decorations. This one
doesn't come along often.

name: Adamant Orb
desc:
An indispensable item used
in Decorations. A rare orb
that houses immense power.

name: Sovereign Orb
desc:
An indispensable item used
in Decorations. Rare and
brimming with fierce power.

name: Armor Stone
desc:
Reacts uniquely to heat.
Combine with other materials
to create equipment coating.

name: Armor Sphere
desc:
Reacts uniquely to heat.
Fuse this to equipment to
increase its strength.

name: Armor Sphere+
desc:
Fuse this high-quality Armor
Sphere to existing equipment
to increase its strength.

name: Adv Armor Sphere
desc:
A dense, rigid Armor Sphere.
Rare, but enables higher-
level equipment upgrades.

name: Hard Armor Sphere
desc:
A thick, dense Armor Sphere.
Use this precious rarity to
push equipment to the limit.

name: Heavy Armor Sphere
desc:
A thick, dense Armor Sphere.
Use this precious rarity to
push armor to the limit.

name: King Armor Sphere
desc:
A brightly glowing Armor Sphere.
Use this scarce commodity to
take your armor to new heights.

name: True Armor Sphere
desc:
An Armor Sphere of near-perfect
purity. Its abilities require
advanced techniques to extract.

name: Mystery Charm
desc:
A modest good luck charm.
What does it do? Finish the
Quest and you'll find out.

name: Shining Charm
desc:
A curious good luck charm.
What does it do? Finish the
Quest and you'll find out.

name: Timeworn Charm
desc:
A powerful good luck charm.
What does it do? Finish the
Quest and you'll find out.

name: Enduring Charm
desc:
A mysterious good-luck charm.
What does it do? Finish the
Quest and you'll find out.

name: Rustshard
desc:
Looks like a lump of dirt,
but it's actually rusted
metal. Try polishing it...

name: Ancient Shard
desc:
A fossil? No, it appears to
be metal... With a little
polish, it could be more.

name: Rare Fish
desc:
A lightly braised fish.
Recovers the red portion of
the Health Gauge when eaten.

name: Burnt Fish
desc:
A fish burnt to a crisp.
Sometimes recovers Health,
but can also cause harm...

name: Gourmet Fish
desc:
Recovers the red portion of
the Health Gauge and
increases natural recovery.

name: Whetfish
desc:
A fish with a dorsal fin
hard enough to be used
to sharpen weapons.

name: Sushifish
desc:
A fatty fish that can restore
a small amount of Health.
Helps cure Bleeding.

name: Sleepyfish
desc:
A fish that contains
sleeping agents.

name: Pin Tuna
desc:
A fish with jaws covered in
tiny, needle-like spikes.

name: Speartuna
desc:
A giant fish that's both rare
and valuable. It looks like it
could be used for something...

name: Popfish
desc:
A fish that literally pops
when it dies.

name: Scatterfish
desc:
A fish that splits into
little pieces when it dies.

name: Burst Arowana
desc:
A fish that bursts open when
it dies.

name: Bomb Arowana
desc:
A fish that explodes when it
dies.

name: Glutton Tuna
desc:
A fish that eats anything --
allowing you to sometimes
get items from its stomach.

name: Gastronome Tuna
desc:
An enormous Glutton Tuna.
Will eat anything, no
matter the size.

name: Ancient Fish
desc:
A precious fish; almost
every part can be used as
material.

name: Small Goldenfish
desc:
A small, rare, gold fish.
Commands a high price.

name: Wanchovy
desc:
A fish that can induce
exhaustion.

name: Blue Cutthroat
desc:
A fish that emits blue light.
Its sharp body will cut you to
pieces if you're not careful.

name: Humspun Conch
desc:
A giant, spiked conch shell. If
you listen closely, you can hear
the melody of the tides within.

name: Armored Bream
desc:
A fish with massive scales,
which have a wyvern-like
quality to them.

name: Sharqskin
desc:
The skin of a carnivorous fish.
Sought after for its unique
feel and texture.

name: Springnight Carp
desc:
A species of carp whose
arrival signals the start
of the breeding season.

name: Tailed Frog
desc:
A rare frog that retained
its tail. This only happens
under special conditions.

name: Guardfish
desc:
An armored fish with a golden
sheen. Sell it at a high price,
or use it in crafting.

name: Insect Husk
desc:
The remains of a dead
insect.

name: Godbug
desc:
An insect said to live
for a thousand years.

name: Bitterbug
desc:
A sharp-tasting bug with innate
healing abilities. Eat one for a
50% chance of curing Poison.

name: Flashbug
desc:
An insect that emits
a powerful flash when
it dies.

name: Thunderbug
desc:
An insect that emits
electricity when struck.
Has many applications.

name: Stinkhopper
desc:
A grasshopper with a foul odor.
Make fishing lures with it; its
scent drives explosive fish wild.

name: Snakebee Larva
desc:
An unusual larva to make
fishing lures with; its scent
drives the best fish wild.

name: Stygian Worm
desc:
Spins a jet-black silk which,
when woven into cloth, can
withstand wyvern claws.

name: Carpenterbug
desc:
Uses viscous fluids and sharp
jaws to construct ant hills
that are a sight to behold.

name: Shiny Beetle
desc:
An insect with dazzling wings.
Its hard shell is often used
as an abrasive.

name: Hercudrome
desc:
Said to be the world's
strongest bug. Used in
forging and other things.

name: Fulgurbug
desc:
Thunderbugs which have been
stimulated by Zinogre. They
emit a pale blue light.

name: King Scarab
desc:
The royal class of the
scarabs, with a hard shell
and lustrous wings.

name: Rare Scarab
desc:
A rare and valuable insect
that greatly assists in the
bonding of metals.

name: Blossom Cricket
desc:
A beautiful bell cricket
resembling a flower. Its sound
opens even the hardest of hearts.

name: Great Hornfly
desc:
An insect with a giant horn,
massive shell, and wings
of butterfly-like beauty.

name: Butterfly Beetle
desc:
A strange insect with the large
jaws of a beetle and the
delicate wings of a butterfly.

name: Great Ladybug
desc:
A giant insect with a very
hard shell. Protects crops
by eating harmful pests.

name: Emperor Hopper
desc:
A grasshopper with an
exceptionally strong shell.
Prized as a crafting material.

name: Flutterfly
desc:
A butterfly with shimmering
wings. So rarely seen in the wild,
many believe it to be a myth.

name: Toxic Kumori
desc:
An insect that possesses a
powerful poison used by
certain tribes for hunting.

name: Large Toxic Kumori
desc:
The largest of the Kumori,
it possesses a deadly poison
banned by many countries.

name: Lethal Kumori
desc:
An irregular Kumori that carries
a fast-acting, lethal poison.
You'd need a miracle to survive...

name: Dracophage Bug
desc:
It likes Dragonfell Berries,
causing it to store Dragon
Element energy in its body.

name: Monster Bone S
Monster Bone M
desc:
A nicely-sized bone. Strong
yet flexible, it's as reliable
as steel and wood.

name: Monster Bone L
desc:
Wyvern bone needed to craft
larger items. The right item
will fuse this to a shell.

name: Mystery Bone
desc:
A weathered bone.
Not sturdy enough
to use for crafting.

name: Unknown Skull
desc:
Animal skull. So worn
and weathered, its
origin is unidentifiable.

name: Huge Unknown Skull
desc:
A large weather-worn skull of
unknown origin. It looks strong
enough to be used in crafting.

name: Monster Bone+
desc:
A high-quality monster bone.
Hard to obtain, but vital for
crafting powerful equipment.

name: Monster Keenbone
desc:
A rare bone with a razor-
sharp tip that retains its
strength even when crafted.

name: Monster Hardbone
desc:
A precious bone rarely yielded
by large wyverns. Difficult to
forge but prized for its strength.

name: Monster Toughbone
desc:
Arguably the strongest type of
bone; it radiates an incredible
strength and presence.

name: Monster Slogbone
desc:
An incredibly strong bone
harvested from a fearsome
wyvern. Its heft is impressive.

name: Elder Dragon Bone
desc:
A bone from an elder dragon.
It exudes the great majesty
of the beast.

name: Lrg ElderDragon Bone
desc:
Top-grade bone from a large
wyvern. Its rough and majestic
shape tells a vivid tale.

name: Avian Finebone
desc:
A bone from a Jaggi or other
bird wyvern. Small in size,
but high in quality.

name: Avian Stoutbone
desc:
The robust bone of a bird
wyvern. Durable and easy
to craft with.

name: Large Herbivore Bone
desc:
The thick, sturdy bone of
a herbivore. Up there with
the best of them.

name: Brute Bone
desc:
The stout bone of a brutish
monster. An easy-to-work
material.

name: Jumbo Bone
desc:
A large, thick bone.
Often cut apart in workshops
for use in crafting.

name: Stoutbone
desc:
The large, sturdy bone of a
beast. Prized by blacksmiths
as a prime forging material.

name: Massive Bone
desc:
An impossibly hard bone from a
large beast. Exceeds all known
standards for crafting material.

name: Dragonbone Relic
desc:
A curiously unfossilized
bone from a dragon that once
roamed these lands.

name: Dragonbone Artifact
desc:
Rare bone from an elder dragon
that once ruled the land.
A mysterious power lies within.

name: Irregular Bone
desc:
A bone with an unusual shape
and color. It can be made
into valuable equipment.

name: Irregular Stoutbone
desc:
An extra hard bone with an
unusual shape and color.
Used to create equipment.

name: Irregular Slogbone
desc:
A bone with an unusual shape
and color. Its unusual sturdiness
is used to forge strong armor.

name: Wyvern Fang
desc:
Used in Bowgun bullet points.
Gunpowder shatters these,
generating shrapnel.

name: Wyvern Claw
desc:
Used in Bowgun bullet points.
Gunpowder triggers a blast
with a wide radius.

name: Sharp Claw
desc:
A shining black claw.
Unlike wyvern claws, this
is shaped to grip objects.

name: Piercing Claw
desc:
Dangerous to touch with
bare hands, it's used as
a knife in some workshops.

name: Sharp Fang
desc:
Fangs come in many shapes
and sizes -- the right fang
for the right job.

name: Crushing Fang
desc:
Fangs come in many shapes
and sizes -- the right fang
for the right job.

name: Bird Wyvern Gem
desc:
A valuable gem that can be
harvested from Jaggi and
other bird wyverns.

name: Fey Wyvern Gem
desc:
An exceptionally pure gem taken
from a bird wyvern. Its fragility
makes it difficult to carve.

name: Wyvern Gem
desc:
Throughout a wyvern's life,
impurities gather and form
this peculiar gem.

name: Lrg Wyvern Gem
desc:
A Wyvern Gem grown especially
large after years of collecting
mass. Emits a peculiar glow.

name: Elder Dragon Blood
desc:
Contains an unknown
ingredient, the object of
much scholarly research.

name: Pure Dragon Blood
desc:
Elder dragon blood that
contains a more potent mix
of its mysterious ingredient.

name: Viscous Dragon Blood
desc:
Rare even among elder
dragons, this mysterious blood
has unknown potential.

name: Steel Egg
desc:
An egg of glittering steel.
Very valuable and rare,
but of no use to a hunter...?

name: Silver Egg
desc:
An egg of glittering silver.
Very valuable and rare,
but of no use to a hunter...?

name: Golden Egg
desc:
An egg of glittering gold.
Insanely valuable and rare,
but of no use to a hunter...?

name: Platinum Egg
desc:
An egg of glittering platinum.
Absurdly valuable and rare,
but of no use to a hunter.

name: Slickaxe
desc:
A small pickaxe that looks
useless for mining. It seems
to have a strange power...

name: Screamer Sac
desc:
A monster organ that emits
an earsplitting sonic blast
when ruptured.

name: Poison Sac
desc:
A monster organ that
contains a lethal toxin.
Handle with extreme care.

name: Toxin Sac
desc:
A monster organ filled with
an extremely potent toxin.
Just touching it is dangerous.

name: Deadly Poison Sac
desc:
A monster's internal organ
filled with a most lethal toxin.
Use extreme care!

name: Paralysis Sac
desc:
A monster organ that contains
paralyzing neurotoxins.

name: Omniplegia Sac
desc:
A monster organ filled with
potent neurotoxins. A single
touch can cause Paralysis.

name: Ultraplegia Sac
desc:
A monster organ filled with
highly concentrated neurotoxins.
Handle with extreme care.

name: Sleep Sac
desc:
A monster organ that
contains a knockout powder
capable of inducing Sleep.

name: Coma Sac
desc:
A monster organ that
contains dangerous powder.
One whiff can induce a coma.

name: Torpor Sac
desc:
A monster organ that can
subdue rampaging monsters
in the blink of an eye.

name: Flame Sac
desc:
A monster organ filled with
flammable powder. Handle
with extreme care.

name: Inferno Sac
desc:
A monster organ filled with
powder that ignites if it so
much as touches air. Danger!

name: Conflagrant Sac
desc:
A monster organ filled with
a highly explosive powder.
Extremely dangerous!

name: Electro Sac
desc:
A monster organ that can
store up electricity, which
is released on impact.

name: Thunder Sac
desc:
A monster organ that can
store up large amounts of
high voltage electricity.

name: Lightning Sac
desc:
A monster organ that can store
electricity as strong as
lightning. Rumbles like thunder.

name: Freezer Sac
Cryo Sac
desc:
A monster organ that has fierce
freezing properties. It can coat
an area in ice in a flash.

name: Aqua Sac
desc:
A monster organ designed to
hold and preserve water.

name: Torrent Sac
desc:
A monster organ designed to
hold and preserve copious
amounts of water.

name: Flood Sac
desc:
A monster organ designed to
hold and preserve tremendous
amounts of water.

name: Dash Extract
desc:
A mysterious substance culled
from certain monsters that
increases endurance.

name: Pale Extract
desc:
Has the ability to amplify the
effects of certain medicines.

name: Hyper Extract
desc:
An unknown Extract taken
from Hyper Monsters. Its
details remain a mystery.

name: Potent Hyper Extract
desc:
A concentrated Extract taken
from Hyper Monsters. Its details
remain a mystery.

name: Hyper Fang
desc:
A fang from a Hyper Monster,
it's darker and stronger
than normal.

name: Hyper Fang+
desc:
An extra sharp fang from a
Hyper Monster, it's darker and
stronger than normal.

name: Hyper Hardfang
desc:
A highly dense fang from a
Hyper Monster, it's black all
over and extremely robust.

name: Hyper Keenfang
desc:
A sharp and weighty fang from
a Hyper Monster, it's black all
over and extremely robust.

name: Hyper Solidfang
desc:
An armor-plated fang from a
Hyper Monster, it's black all
over and extremely robust.

name: Hyper Claw
desc:
A claw from a Hyper Monster,
it's darker and stronger
than normal.

name: Hyper Claw+
desc:
A sharpened claw from a Hyper
monster, it's darker and
stronger than normal.

name: Hyper Heavyclaw
desc:
A highly dense claw from a
Hyper Monster, it's black all
over and extremely robust.

name: Hyper Keenclaw
desc:
A sharp and weighty claw from
a Hyper Monster, it's black all
over and extremely robust.

name: Hyper Solidclaw
desc:
An armor-plated claw from a
Hyper Monster, it's black all
over and extremely robust.

name: Hyper Monster Bone
desc:
A monster bone from a Hyper
monster, it's darker and
stronger than normal.

name: Hyper MnstrToughbone
desc:
A monster bone from a Hyper
monster, it's black all over and
extremely robust.

name: Hyper MnstrSlogbone
desc:
A monster bone from a Hyper
monster, it's black all over and
extremely heavy.

name: Hyper Horn+
desc:
A sharpened horn from a Hyper
monster, it's darker and
stronger than normal.

name: Hyper Hardhorn
desc:
A sharpened horn from a Hyper
monster, it's black all over and
extremely robust.

name: Hyper Flame Sac
desc:
A flame sac from a Hyper
monster, it's darker and
stronger than normal.

name: Hyper Conflagrant Sac
desc:
A flame sac from a Hyper
monster, it's black all over
and extremely robust.

name: Hyper Pyroscale
desc:
A pyroscale from a Hyper
monster, it's darker and
stronger than normal.

name: Hyper Flarescale
desc:
A flarescale from a Hyper
monster, it's black all over
and extremely robust.

name: Hyper Aqua Sac
desc:
An aqua sac from a Hyper
monster, it's darker and
stronger than normal.

name: Hyper Flood Sac
desc:
A flood sac from a Hyper
monster, it's black all over
and extremely robust.

name: Hyper Fluid
desc:
A strange liquid from a Hyper
monster, it's darker and
stronger than normal.

name: Hyper Viscous Fluid
desc:
A strange, thick liquid from a
Hyper monster, it's black and
extremely robust.

name: Hyper Electro Sac
desc:
An electro sac from a Hyper
monster, it's darker and
stronger than normal.

name: Hyper Lightning Sac
desc:
A lightning sac from a Hyper
monster, it's black all over and
extremely robust.

name: Hyper Charged Shell
desc:
A charged shell from a Hyper
monster, it's darker and
stronger than normal.

name: Hyper Amped Shell
desc:
An amped shell from a Hyper
monster, it's black all over
and extremely robust.

name: Hyper Shockfur
desc:
Shockfur from a Hyper
monster, it's darker and
stronger than normal.

name: Hyper Fluxfur
desc:
Fluxfur from a Hyper monster,
it's black all over and
extremely robust.

name: Hyper Ice Block
desc:
An ice block from a Hyper
monster, it's darker and
stronger than normal.

name: Hyper Ice Chunk
desc:
An ice chunk from a Hyper
monster, it's black all over
and extremely robust.

name: Hyper Draco. Scale
desc:
A Dracophage scale from a
Hyper Monster, it's darker
and stronger than normal.

name: Hyper Draco. Scale+
desc:
A Dracophage scale from a
Hyper Monster, it's black all
over and extremely robust.

name: Hyper Toxin
desc:
Poison taken from a Hyper
monster, it's darker and
stronger than normal.

name: Hyper Potent Toxin
desc:
Potent poison taken from
a Hyper monster, it's black
and highly concentrated.

name: Hyper Paratoxin
desc:
Paralysis poison from a Hyper
monster, it's darker and
stronger than normal.

name: Hyper Potent Paratoxin
desc:
Paralysis poison from a Hyper
monster, it's black and highly
concentrated.

name: Hyper Sleep Sac
desc:
A sleep sac from a Hyper
monster, it's darker and
stronger than normal.

name: Hyper Coma Sac
desc:
A sleep sac from a Hyper
monster, it's black all over
and extremely durable.

name: Hyper Narcotoxin
desc:
Sleep poison from a Hyper
monster, it's darker and
stronger than normal.

name: Hyper Potent Narcotoxin
desc:
Sleep poison from a Hyper
monster, it's black and highly
concentrated.

name: Hyper Catalyst
desc:
Explosive liquid from a
Hyper Monster, it's darker
and stronger than normal.

name: Hyper Catalyst+
desc:
Explosive liquid from a
Hyper Monster, it's black
and highly concentrated.

name: Felyne Fur Ruby
desc:
A priceless ruby formed by
the rare hardening of a
Felyne hairball.

name: Larinoth Hide
desc:
The hide of the gigantic
Larinoth. Its color is like
fresh grass in springtime.

name: Larinoth Finehide
desc:
The hide of the gigantic Larinoth.
Lauded for its beautiful hues
and all-around toughness.

name: Gargwa Feather
desc:
A big, beautiful feather
plucked from a Gargwa. Often
used as a fashion accessory.

name: Gargwa Finefeather
desc:
A high quality feather plucked
from a Gargwa. Stylish, and can
be used to reinforce armor.

name: Moofah Horn
desc:
The horn of a Moofah. Since
its shape varies by gender,
it has a variety of uses.

name: Moofah Fleeceball
desc:
A fleeceball that's white and
fluffy like a cloud. It makes
supple yet strong thread.

name: Moofah Heavyhorn
desc:
The hefty horn of a Moofah.
Resilient and easy to craft, it's
a material with many uses.

name: Kelbi Horn
desc:
An infusion of powdered
Kelbi Horn that works
wonders on stomachaches.

name: Warm Pelt
desc:
A pelt from a small animal.
Used for many things, but
mostly just regular clothes.

name: High-quality Pelt
desc:
Feels wonderful to the
touch. Difficult to carve
but valued by the Guild.

name: Prized Pelt
desc:
A quality pelt from a small
animal. Often used in
clothing for its comfort.

name: Anteka Antler
desc:
An antler often used as raw
material for armor. Popular
with interior decorators.

name: Anteka Proud Antler
desc:
A hefty antler that's valued
by seasoned hunters and
collectors alike.

name: Rhenoplos Shell
desc:
A shell that is very strong
despite coming from such
a small monster.

name: Rhenoplos Carapace
desc:
A carapace grown thick and
hard over many years. Incredibly
strong for a small-monster part.

name: Rhenoplos Scalp
desc:
A sturdy part of the skull
that yields, shall we say,
dashing results?

name: Slagtoth Hide+
desc:
Firm, lustrous hide often cut
into large slabs. Prized for its
water-resistant properties.

name: Supple Piel
desc:
A flexible, elastic hide from
a leviathan. A useful material
that requires effort to obtain.

name: Monster Fluid
desc:
A liquid bugs suck from
monsters. Mixes with insect
gastric fluids to form adhesive.

name: Monster Broth
desc:
A broth made from only the
thickest of a monster's
juices. Quite rich.

name: Monster Essence
desc:
A broth made from only the
thickest, choicest parts of
a monster's juices. Gross?

name: Bnahabra Shell
desc:
Just as useful as sturdy
wyvern shell in the hands
of a clever craftsman.

name: Bnahabra Carapace
desc:
The hardest part of the shell.
Reveals curious properties
when forged.

name: Bnahabra Wing
desc:
Difficult to forge with --
the results vary depending
on which surface you use.

name: Bnahabra Razorwing
desc:
A wing that slices like a
well-honed knife. Difficult
to use in forging.

name: Altaroth Jaw
desc:
These durable mouthparts are
surprisingly difficult to
carve loose.

name: Altaroth Stomach
desc:
A transparent sac cut from
an Altaroth's abdomen, used
to store who knows what.

name: Quality Stomach
desc:
A high-quality sac cut from an
Altaroth's abdomen. Its refined
material is thin but durable.

name: Premium Stomach
desc:
A rare find, as Altaroth
stomachs go. It can never
be torn, or so they say.

name: Vespoid Shell
desc:
With special materials,
it can be worked into
very strong armor.

name: Vespoid Carapace
desc:
The hardest part of a Vespoid
shell. Exhibits special
properties when processed.

name: Vespoid Wing
desc:
Difficult to forge with --
the results vary depending
on which surface you use.

name: Vespoid Innerwing
desc:
Blade-shaped innerwing of a
Vespoid. The secret behind
the beast's killing prowess.

name: Vespoid Razorwing
desc:
Much sharper than a Vespoid
Innerwing. A simple graze is
more than enough to cut.

name: Hornetaur Shell
desc:
With special materials,
it can be worked into
very strong armor.

name: Hornetaur Carapace
desc:
The hard part of a Hornetaur
shell. Exhibits special
properties when worked.

name: Hornetaur Wing
desc:
A hard-to-work material.
Appears pearl-like when
struck by light.

name: Hornetaur Innerwing
desc:
A blade-shaped innerwing of
a Hornetaur. The secret to
its killing prowess.

name: Hornetaur Razorwing
desc:
Much sharper than a Hornetaur
Innerwing. A simple graze is
more than enough to cut.

name: Hornetaur Head
desc:
With special materials,
it can be worked into
strong weapons or armor.

name: Konchu Shell
desc:
A shield-like insect shell
as hard as any mineral. It
emits an indescribable glow.

name: Konchu Carapace
desc:
A shield-like insect shell
so hard that only a supreme
craftsman can forge it.

name: Konchu Cortex
desc:
A shield-like insect shell
so hard that only a supreme
craftsman can forge it.

name: Shocking Extract
desc:
A concentrate of Thunderbug
essence that releases an
electrical discharge when struck.

name: Shocking Jelly
desc:
A gelatinous substance made
from Great Thunderbugs. Easy to
use and generates high voltage.

name: Remobra Hide
desc:
A glossy and subdued black
hide taken from a Remobra.

name: Remobra Hide+
desc:
A lustrous and elegant black
hide taken from a Remobra.

name: Remobra Finehide
desc:
The highest quality in Remobra
skins. It shines with a luster
reminiscent of a black pearl.

name: Striped Skin
desc:
Unassuming black-and-red
hues from a Remobra
that some hunters swear by.

name: Striped Finehide
desc:
Classy Remobra stripes on a
resilient hide--a winner in any
hunter's book.

name: Remobra Head
desc:
The snake-like head of a
Remobra. It still
looks ready to pounce!

name: Mighty Remobra Head
desc:
The snake-like head of a
Remobra. Being in its presence
may induce mild panic.

name: Bird Wyvern Fang
desc:
A sharp, durable fang from
a bird wyvern. Used to make
Bowgun ammo.

name: Maccao Scale
desc:
A scale carved from a Maccao.
Although soft, it offers good
protection from the elements.

name: Maccao Scale+
desc:
A superior scale from a Maccao.
Its rigidity and durability make
for excellent armor.

name: Maccao Shard
desc:
An especially tough scale carved
from a Maccao that offers
resistance to vicious attacks.

name: Maccao Hide
desc:
A Maccao hide stripped of its
scales. Its elasticity allows for
free and easy movement.

name: Great Maccao Scale
desc:
A scale that gets stronger when
struck. Scales from the hands
and feet are especially tough.

name: Great Maccao Scale+
desc:
A superior Great Maccao scale.
The rarer, yellow scales are
often used as decorations.

name: Great Maccao Shard
desc:
An especially thick Great
Maccao scale that's become
hardened over the years.

name: Great Maccao Hide
desc:
The braver the specimen, the
duller and stronger this red
hide becomes. Highly prized.

name: Great Maccao Hide+
desc:
Top-grade red Great Maccao
hide. It is valued for its scars,
and is used to reward valor.

name: Great Maccao Piel
desc:
The high quality hide of
a Great Maccao, made
resilient from old wounds.

name: Champion's Crest
desc:
Maccao males have decorative
feathers, whose beauty is
directly related to strength.

name: Glorious Crest
desc:
This eye-catching plumage
indicates alpha status in the
Great Maccao hierarchy.

name: Maccao Tailspike
desc:
Extremely hard, it provides
balance, gripping the ground
like claws.

name: Maccao Tailspear
desc:
A particularly hefty tailspike,
even by Maccao standards.
Indispensable for crafting.

name: Jaggi Scale
desc:
A scale carved from a Jaggi.
Popular among hunters for its
beauty and crafting versatility.

name: Jaggi Scale+
desc:
A vividly-colored superior
Jaggi scale that can be used
to produce hardier equipment.

name: Jaggi Shard
desc:
An excellent Jaggi scale favored
by hunters as it can be easily
worked into the toughest gear.

name: Jaggi Hide
desc:
Soft hide from beneath a Jaggi's
scales. Cheap and easy to work
with, it has numerous uses.

name: Jaggi Piel
desc:
Very thick, even for Jaggi hide.
A distinctively smooth material
that's easy to work with.

name: Velociprey Scale
desc:
A scale obtained by carving
up a Velociprey.
Blue and black in color.

name: Velociprey Scale+
desc:
A scale stripped from a
Velociprey. It can be made
into light, durable armor.

name: Velociprey Shard
desc:
A thick scale carved from a
Velociprey. It's light and easy
to carry, yet hardy.

name: Velociprey Hide
desc:
A hide stripped of its
scales. Used to join the
plates in a suit of armor.

name: Velociprey Hide+
desc:
The high-quality, descaled
hide of a Velociprey, it
has many applications.

name: Velocidrome Hide
desc:
The hide of a Velociprey
leader. It bears the scars
of a leadership role.

name: Velocidrome Hide+
desc:
Top-grade Velocidrome hide.
It's extremely tough, despite
being covered in scars.

name: Velocidrome Piel
desc:
Dense Velocidrome hide.
It can take a lot of punishment,
as evidenced by all the scars.

name: Velocidrome Claw
desc:
The claw of a Velocidrome.
Its tip is as deadly as a
sharpened knife.

name: Velocidrome Claw+
desc:
The sharp claw of a
Velocidrome. It can easily
slice through prey.

name: Velocidrome Talon
desc:
The sharpest of Velocidrome
claws, allowing it to mercilessly
rip its prey to shreds.

name: Velocidrome Head
desc:
A large head with a crest.
You'd look pretty fierce
if you put it on.

name: Genprey Fang
desc:
The poisonous fang of a
Genprey. The paralyzing
toxin works even on wyverns.

name: Genprey Scale
desc:
Scale from a Genprey.
Acts as camouflage in
desert areas.

name: Genprey Scale+
desc:
Scale taken from a
Genprey. Strong enough to
repel a wyvern's fangs.

name: Genprey Shard
desc:
Superior scale taken from a
Genprey, that not even the
sharpest of fangs can pierce.

name: Genprey Hide
desc:
A hide with all the scales
removed. Can be tanned and
turned into leather.

name: Genprey Hide+
desc:
The high-quality, descaled
hide of a Genprey. It can
neutralize neurotoxins.

name: Gendrome Hide
desc:
Sturdy green hide from
a Gendrome. Perfect for
making strong armor.

name: Gendrome Hide+
desc:
A high-quality green hide from
a Gendrome. The hides of
leaders are especially tough.

name: Gendrome Piel
desc:
Superior Gendrome hide,
toughened by long years of
leading the herd.

name: Gendrome Fang
desc:
The large and developed fang
of a Gendrome. Be careful of
its powerful neurotoxin.

name: Gendrome Fang+
desc:
The large and sharpened fang
of a Gendrome. Its tip excretes
a deadly neurotoxin.

name: Gendrome Hardfang
desc:
A mighty Gendrome fang, able
to rend the flesh of prey and
inject a vicious neurotoxin.

name: Gendrome Head
desc:
The head of a Gendrome.
Noted for its two crests.

name: Ioprey Fang
desc:
A fang filled with deadly
poison. Handle with care!

name: Ioprey Scale
desc:
Scale from an Ioprey. The
poison irritates the skin
so has been removed.

name: Ioprey Scale+
desc:
Superior scale from an Ioprey.
Can be used in crafting once
the poison has been removed.

name: Ioprey Shard
desc:
A massive poisonous scale from
an Ioprey. Those who can work it
safely are few and far between.

name: Ioprey Hide
desc:
Descaled hide, often made
into belts. Red belts are
used in decorations.

name: Ioprey Hide+
desc:
High-quality, descaled
Ioprey hide. The red
skin resists poison.

name: Iodrome Hide
desc:
A sturdy red hide from
an Iodrome. Perfect for
making strong armor.

name: Iodrome Hide+
desc:
Sturdy hide from the toughest
Iodromes. It is very rare and
hardly ever seen at market.

name: Iodrome Piel
desc:
High-grade Iodrome hide.
Unbelievably strong, perfect for
leading a large herd.

name: Iodrome Violet Scale
desc:
A violet scale carved from an
Iodrome. It is more difficult to
obtain than regular scales.

name: Iodrome Violet Scale+
desc:
A quality violet Iodrome scale.
Its deep color borders on
black--a sign of its quality.

name: Iodrome Violet Shard
desc:
An Iodrome scale of the highest
caliber, proven by its deep
hue, virtually black.

name: Iodrome Head
desc:
An Iodrome head with
a large, eye-catching crest.

name: Giaprey Scale
desc:
A scale carved from a Giaprey.
The color allows you to stalk
prey in the snow undetected.

name: Giaprey Scale+
desc:
A high-quality scale carved
from a Giaprey. Used to craft
even better equipment.

name: Giaprey Shard
desc:
A superior scale carved from a
Giaprey, used to forge high
performance armor.

name: Giaprey Hide
desc:
Hide stripped of all its
scales. Used to make
clothing for villagers.

name: Giaprey Hide+
desc:
High quality hide carved from
a Giaprey. Can be used to
craft sturdy equipment.

name: Giadrome Hide+
desc:
Extra-high quality hide carved
from a Giadrome. Often used to
forge powerful armor.

name: Giadrome Piel
desc:
The best Giadrome hide one can
find, used by any hunter wishing
to survive the frozen wastes.

name: Giadrome Claw+
desc:
Sharp claw recovered from a
Giadrome. Used for weaponry,
but also for decoration.

name: Giadrome Talon
desc:
A thickened Giadrome claw.
Keen-edged and able to cut
like a blade.

name: Giadrome Head
desc:
Giadromes seem quite proud of
their beautifully colored crests.
Wouldn't you be?

name: Arzuros Pelt
desc:
A pelt carved from an Arzuros.
The white portion is soft, while
the blue is short and taut.

name: Arzuros Pelt+
desc:
A splendid Arzuros pelt.
Sturdy enough to survive in
harsh mountainous terrain.

name: Arzuros Fur
desc:
Exceptional Arzuros fur. Perfect
for hunters to wrap up in, owing
to it being both soft and tough.

name: Arzuros Shell
desc:
A shell piece from an Arzuros's
head or back. Bends willingly
and is easy to forge.

name: Arzuros Carapace
desc:
A quality Arzuros carapace.
The thick shell can withstand
bites from ordinary fangs.

name: Arzuros Cortex
desc:
A superior Arzuros cortex.
This highly-developed shell is a
huge thorn in all hunters' sides.

name: Arzuros Brace
desc:
A brace from an Arzuros's
forelegs. Its sharp points give
forged equipment a wild flavor.

name: Arzuros Brace+
desc:
A strong Arzuros brace.
Its thorn-like protrusions
make paw swipes deadly.

name: Arzuros Allbrace
desc:
A supreme brace found only
on certain Arzuros. Its tough,
thornlike protrusions silence foes.

name: Redhelm Pelt
desc:
A pelt hard enough to pierce
flesh. Its looks embody the
Redhelm Arzuros's brutality.

name: Redhelm Pelt+
desc:
A quality pelt that's hard
and durable. Epitomizes the
Redhelm's viciousness.

name: Redhelm Fur
desc:
The bristles in the Redhelm's fur
show how shockingly ferocious
it can be.

name: Redhelm Shell
desc:
A shell from a Redhelm Arzuros.
Even its hard and sturdy shell
looks fierce.

name: Redhelm Carapace
desc:
A superior Redhelm Arzuros
scale. Even its thick and sturdy
shell looks ferocious.

name: Redhelm Cortex
desc:
A superior Redhelm cortex.
Extremely tough, evincing a
ferocity that can dazzle the eye.

name: Redhelm Ragehair
desc:
The hair from the head of a
Redhelm Arzuros. Its looks
befit the beast's wild nature.

name: Redhelm Furyhair
desc:
High quality hair from the head
of a Redhelm Arzuros that
embodies its ferocity.

name: Redhelm Zenith Furyhair
desc:
Redhelm head hair of the highest
quality. Extremely thick, showing
off the creature's pure rage.

name: Lagombi Pelt
desc:
A white pelt carved from a
Lagombi. One touch and you'll
be hooked on its soft, fluffy fur.

name: Lagombi Pelt+
desc:
A quality white Lagombi pelt.
Its glossy, frosty shine makes it
a sought-after luxury item.

name: Lagombi Fur
desc:
The very finest Lagombi fur,
durable and yet surprisingly
soft. A top-shelf item.

name: Lagombi Ear
desc:
The long ear of a Lagombi.
A lifetime in frigid environments
has made it hard as a shell.

name: Lagombi Ear+
desc:
An impressive Lagombi ear.
Highly developed, it can become
sharp as steel if polished.

name: Lagombi Plastron
desc:
A shell piece from a Lagombi's
belly. Its ridges are what allow
the Lagombi to slide on ice.

name: Lagombi Plastron+
desc:
A strong, sticky, and thick
Lagombi Plastron. Used
to make superior equipment.

name: Lagombi Cuirass
desc:
Tougher and thicker even than
Lagombi Plastrons, and glints
from many ice-polishings.

name: Lagombi Iceclaw
desc:
A Lagombi claw that's cold to
the touch. Permanently covered
in ice from a frigid climate.

name: Lagombi Frozenclaw
desc:
A Lagombi claw surrounded by
cold air. Wounds it causes
freeze over in an instant.

name: Lagombi Frigidclaw
desc:
Fearsomely sharp and tough,
even among Lagombi claws, able
to tear up and freeze prey.

name: Snowbaron Pelt
desc:
A pelt that was carved from a
Snowbaron Lagombi. It looks
fluffy and is soft to the touch.

name: Snowbaron Pelt+
desc:
A hardened pelt taken from a
Snowbaron Lagombi. Although
stiff, it has a pleasing feel to it.

name: Snowbaron Fur
desc:
Particularly durable fur. The hairs
feel wiry but the prickly sensation
is actually quite comfortable.

name: Snowbaron Plastron
desc:
A shell piece from a Snowbaron
Lagombi's belly. It is known for
its deep ridges.

name: Snowbaron Plastron+
desc:
A high-quality Snowbaron
Lagombi plastron. Its deep
ridges give it a nice shape.

name: Snowbaron Cuirass
desc:
Even better than the Snowbaron
Lagombi plastron, its pleasing
shape approaches fine art.

name: Volvidon Shell
desc:
The heat-resistant shell of
a Volvidon. Unaffected even
by boiling lava.

name: Volvidon Carapace
desc:
A thick Volvidon carapace.
Extra elasticity means extreme
pressure is required to forge it.

name: Volvidon Cortex
desc:
A heavy Volvidon cortex.
Difficult to forge with, but can
produce very powerful gear.

name: Volvidon Claw
desc:
A claw from a Volvidon's
forelegs. Dramatically increases
the power of a wide swing.

name: Volvidon Claw+
desc:
A hard, sharp Volvidon claw.
Constant exposure to heat has
tempered it like steel.

name: Volvidon Talon
desc:
A punishing Volvidon claw.
Its solidity and sharpness
is almost overwhelming.

name: Volvi Rickrack
desc:
The jagged shell of a Volvidon's
back. Its high elasticity makes it
ideal for crafting flexible gear.

name: Large Volvi Rickrack
desc:
A larger variety of Volvidon shell.
It combines flexibility and
durability in one package.

name: Kut-Ku Scale
desc:
Pink scale from a Kut-Ku.
Fire resistant. Can be found
in the field.

name: Kut-Ku Scale+
desc:
Superior scale from a Kut-Ku.
Its size and weight make it
look classier than normal.

name: Kut-Ku Shard
desc:
A superb Kut-Ku scale. It's
rare to see scales mature to
this degree.

name: Kut-Ku Shell
desc:
The Fire-resistant shell
of a Kut-Ku.

name: Kut-Ku Carapace
desc:
Harder than Kut-Ku Shell,
this material is also
known as Gravite.

name: Kut-Ku Cortex
desc:
A stout outer shell, much
harder than a carapace.
Also called Mediastinum.

name: Kut-Ku Ear
desc:
The Fire-resistant ear of
a Kut-Ku. Used to prevent
Bowguns backfiring.

name: Kut-Ku Auricle
desc:
A Kut-Ku's Fire-resistant
ear. The flexible material
is a good base for armor.

name: Kut-Ku Luckear
desc:
A full grown Kut-Ku ear.
Considered a good luck charm
due to its texture and form.

name: Giant Beak
desc:
The huge, sturdy beak
of a Yian Kut-Ku.

name: Splendid Beak
desc:
Finding a large, beautiful
beak in this condition is
quite rare! Splendid!

name: Kut-Ku Webbing
desc:
Webbing from a Kut-Ku
wing. Better than animal
skin as a fusing material.

name: Kut-Ku Weave
desc:
Bulky webbing from a Kut-Ku
wing, valued for its greater than
normal powers of endurance.

name: Hyper Kut-Ku Scale
desc:
Darker than normal Kut-Ku
scales, this Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Kut-Ku Shard
desc:
Darker than normal Kut-Ku
scales, this tough Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Rubbery Hide
desc:
Highly elastic Gypceros
hide. A good insulator,
resistant to electricity.

name: Rubbery Hide+
desc:
High-quality, highly
elastic Gypceros hide.
Gives off a strange scent.

name: Rubbery Finehide
desc:
A special, highly elastic
Gypceros hide. It absorbs
any attack.

name: Gypceros Webbing
desc:
Webbing from a Gypceros
wing. A good insulator, it is
also resistant to poison.

name: Gypceros Weave
desc:
Bulky webbing from a Gypceros
wing. Its improved insulation and
toxin resistance make it valuable.

name: Gypceros Wing
desc:
A wing from a Gypceros. It is
highly elastic and is a good
insulator against electricity.

name: Gypceros Head
desc:
The uniquely shaped head
of a Gypceros. A must have
for Gypceros lovers!

name: Gypceros Hardhead
desc:
The hard, rubber-like head of a
Gypceros. The rock-like noggin's
popular among Gypceros fans.

name: Hyper Gypceros Hide
desc:
Darker than normal Gypceros
hide, this Hyper hide
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Gypceros Piel
desc:
Darker than normal Gypceros
hide, this hardy Hyper hide
emits an ominous glow.

name: Azurefeather
desc:
The blue scalefeather of a
Malfestio, the secret behind
its silent flight.

name: Azurefeather+
desc:
A high-quality Malfestio
scalefeather. Used in clothing
as well as armor.

name: Azure Plume
desc:
A scalefeather only found on a
small number of Malfestios. Shines
with ethereal colors.

name: Malfestio Webbing
desc:
Webbing from a Malfestio wing.
Its scales gather sound and
emit a strange echo pattern.

name: Malfestio Wing
desc:
The deep blue wing of a
Malfestio. Widely known
for its beautiful curves.

name: Malfestio Grandwing
desc:
Malfestio wing with a refined
curve, whose vivid blue color
dazzles anyone who sees it.

name: Malfestio Wingtalon
desc:
A hard talon found at the
end of a Malfestio wing.
It's as sharp as a sword.

name: Malfestio Wingtalon+
desc:
A high-quality talon from a
Malfestio wing. Hard and sharp,
it's difficult to work with.

name: Malfestio Hrd Wingtalon
desc:
A high-quality talon from a
Malfestio wing. Very hard and
can be made exquisitely sharp.

name: Malfestio Ear
desc:
The ear of a Malfestio. Smooth
to the touch, it's quite muscular
due to its constant movement.

name: Malfestio Luckear
desc:
A big fleshy piece of
Malfestio ear which has a
multitude of uses.

name: Malfestio Tailfeather
desc:
The flamboyant tail feather of
a Malfestio. Its color gradually
changes from blue to gold.

name: Malfestio Tailblade
desc:
A high-quality tail feather
taken from a Malfestio.
As beautiful as it is dangerous.

name: Malfestio Goldfeather
desc:
The magnificent golden feather
of a Malfestio. Collectors prize
it for its sense of flair.

name: Malfestio Goldfeather+
desc:
A particularly high quality
golden feather which enchants
anyone who gazes upon it.

name: Hyper Azurefeather
desc:
Darker than normal
Malfestio scalefeathers, it
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Azurefeather+
desc:
Darker than normal Malfestio
scalefeathers, this tough Hyper
feather emits an ominous glow.

name: Nightcloak Plume
desc:
A fine feather taken from a
Nightcloak Malfestio. The color
changes with viewing angle.

name: Nightcloak Grandwing
desc:
The plumage taken from a
Nightcloak Malfestio is extra
fine and deep in color.

name: Nightcloak Clearscale
desc:
Camouflages a Nightcloak in the
wild, but weapons fashioned with
them stand out in a crowd.

name: Garuga Scale
desc:
A scale carved from Yian
Garuga. It shines an
ominous purple.

name: Garuga Scale+
desc:
Superior Garuga scale.
Looks like a Kut-Ku scale,
but it's much tougher.

name: Garuga Shard
desc:
A top-grade Garuga scale. It
sparkles like purple quartz
and is just as hard.

name: Garuga Shell
desc:
A rare item, also in great
demand as a research
material.

name: Garuga Carapace
desc:
Garuga Shell that's become
strong over the years. Great
skill is needed to work it.

name: Garuga Cortex
desc:
A heavy, dark purple outer
shell with an unusually
intimidating air about it.

name: Garuga Ear
desc:
Its shape and form show a
different evolutionary
path than Yian Kut-Ku.

name: Garuga Auricle
desc:
Well-developed Garuga Ear.
It's said to heighten one's
senses when crafted into armor.

name: Sharpened Beak
desc:
The sharpened beak of a Yian
Garuga. Looks fiercer than
that of a Kut-Ku.

name: Rejuvenated Beak
desc:
A Yian Garuga beak. Its color,
luster, and the jawline's
angle have been restored.

name: Garuga Wing
desc:
A first class material that
requires high crafting
skills to work with.

name: Garuga Fellwing
desc:
A large, well-developed Garuga
wing. It's highly sought after
by crafters the world round.

name: Garuga Tail
desc:
The tail of a Yian Garuga.
Responds to shocks by
spouting a powerful venom.

name: Garuga Lash
desc:
A tough, hard tail that stores
within a deadly poison that
kills its target in seconds.

name: Garuga Mane
desc:
Mane from a Yian Garuga.
Unusually intimidating.

name: Garuga Silverpelt
desc:
A shimmering silver pelt that
mesmerizes all with its beauty
when it flutters.

name: Hyper Garuga Scale
desc:
Darker than normal Garuga
scales, this Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Garuga Shard
desc:
Darker than normal Garuga
scales, this tough Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Deadeye Scale
desc:
A scale taken from a Deadeye
Yian Garuga. Bears the scars
of many hard-fought battles.

name: Deadeye Scale+
desc:
A hardened scale of a Deadeye
Yian Garuga. Bears the scars
of many hard-fought battles.

name: Deadeye Shard
desc:
The thick top shell of a Deadeye
Yian Garuga. Bears the scars
of many hard-fought battles.

name: Deadeye Shell
desc:
The shell of a Deadeye Yian
Garuga. Bears the scars
of many hard-fought battles.

name: Deadeye Carapace
desc:
A hardened shell of a Deadeye
Yian Garuga. Bears the scars
of many hard-fought battles.

name: Deadeye Cortex
desc:
A very hard Deadeye Yian
Garuga shell. Bears the scars
of many hard-fought battles.

name: Mosswine Hide
desc:
A musty hide covered
in moss.

name: Mosswine Thick Hide
desc:
A thick, musty hide
covered in moss.

name: Bullfango Pelt
desc:
A pelt from a Bullfango,
covered in bristly fur.

name: Bullfango Pelt+
desc:
A high-quality pelt from a
Bullfango. It's as tough as
it is bristly.

name: Bullfango Thickfur
desc:
A top-quality pelt from
a Bullfango. The fur is
particularly dense and bristly.

name: Bullfango Head
desc:
A Bullfango head, complete
with two splendid tusks.

name: Bulldrome Hide
desc:
The hide of a Bulldrome.
Its bristliness has a certain
beauty to it.

name: Bulldrome Hide+
desc:
The tough, unblemished
hide of a Bulldrome.

name: Bulldrome Thickhide
desc:
The thick skin from a Bulldrome.
It's too tough to get scratched
through regular use.

name: Bulldrome Tusk
desc:
A majestic Bulldrome Tusk.
The damaged surface tells
the tale of many battles.

name: Bulldrome Tusk+
desc:
The large tusk of a majestic
Bulldrome. It has been
hardened through battle.

name: Bulldrome Hardtusk
desc:
The large, hard tusk of a
majestic Bulldrome. Hardened
through countless battles.

name: Conga Pelt+
desc:
The hard pelt of a Conga.
The thick fur can be used to
make long-lasting equipment.

name: Conga Fur
desc:
The hard fur of a Conga has to
be sanitized before use, but
its toughness is top notch.

name: Beastly Fang
desc:
A large fang from a Fanged
Beast that can chomp the
hardest of boulders in half.

name: Congalala Pelt+
desc:
The stout fur of a
Congalala. Important
crafting material.

name: Congalala Fur
desc:
The stout hairs of this pelt,
coupled with its glossy coat
make it highly valuable.

name: Congalala Fang
desc:
The fang of a Congalala.
Solid enough to crunch
objects into dust.

name: Congalala Claw+
desc:
A long, hard, sharp claw
with a wild nature that
makes crafting difficult.

name: Vibrant Pelt
desc:
Vibrant hair that grows on
the head of a Congalala.
The colors are lovely.

name: Vibrant Fur
desc:
The best vibrant hair from
the head of a Congalala is
beautiful and tough.

name: Congalala Hardclaw
desc:
Talons evolved specifically for
combat. The natural weapon
of Congalala.

name: Hyper Congalala Pelt+
desc:
Darker than normal Congalala
fur, this Hyper fur emits an
ominous glow.

name: Blango Pelt
desc:
A snow white Blango Pelt. It
protects the body against
the mountain cold.

name: Blango Pelt+
desc:
Keeps you toasty in frigid
temps; harder to work with
than normal Blango Pelts.

name: Blango Fur
desc:
This tough Blango fur is as
beautiful as it is fascinating
to craft items with.

name: Blangonga Pelt
desc:
White fur with astounding
thermal properties and as
strong as an iron chain.

name: Blangonga Pelt+
desc:
The hardened pelt of a
Blangonga. The needle-like
hairs are prized material.

name: Blangonga Fur
desc:
The tough fur of a Blangonga
is harder than the depths of
winter.

name: Blangonga Fang
desc:
The fang of the killer
Blangonga. As sharp and
deadly as a dagger.

name: Blangonga Fang+
desc:
A Blangonga dogtooth. As
large as a human thigh, it
has potential as a weapon.

name: Blangonga Hardfang
desc:
A Blangonga tooth that
looks sharp enough to use
as a skewer for cooking with.

name: Blangonga Whisker
desc:
A fine hair that sprouted
from the face of a
Blangonga troop leader.

name: Leather Beast Pelt
desc:
The fine tough skin of a
Blangonga troop leader displays
its authority and might.

name: Blangonga Tail
desc:
The smooth feeling of a
Blangonga Tail is
undeniably appealing.

name: Blangonga Lash
desc:
The tail of this Blangonga
is silkier to the touch than
fresh powder snow.

name: Hyper Blangonga Pelt
desc:
Darker than normal Blangonga
pelt, this Hyper pelt
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Blangonga Pelt+
desc:
Darker than normal Blangonga
pelt, this Hyper pelt
emits an ominous glow.

name: Kecha Pelt+
desc:
A quality Kecha Wacha pelt
that manages to be durable,
yet still soft to the touch.

name: Kecha Fur
desc:
A fine Kecha Wacha pelt
with a warm color and soft,
sturdy coat. Very popular.

name: Kecha Grandbone
desc:
A quality, hardened arm bone
that makes excellent armor
in a gifted forger's hands.

name: Kecha Leadbone
desc:
A dense arm bone whose
slender sturdiness makes it
fine weapon material.

name: Kecha Talon
desc:
A thick, sharp talon that
evolved for climbing
up ivy.

name: Kecha Ripper
desc:
A unique hooked talon for
crossing vines. Poses a
threat in battle as well.

name: Kecha Ear+
desc:
The unmistakable, ocellated
ear of a Kecha Wacha. Larger
spots fetch a higher price.

name: Kecha Auricle
desc:
The unmistakable, ocellated
ear of a Kecha Wacha. Larger
spots fetch a higher price.

name: Kecha Tail
desc:
A tail with soft strands of
hair. It feels wonderful to
the touch.

name: Kecha Lash
desc:
A quality Kecha Wacha tail.
Strong and supple, it may as
well count as a third arm.

name: Hyper Kecha Pelt
desc:
Darker than normal Kecha
pelt, this Hyper pelt
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Kecha Pelt+
desc:
Darker than normal Kecha
pelt, this tough Hyper pelt
emits an ominous glow.

name: Small Lobstershell
desc:
The shell from a King
Lobster. A rare find.

name: Large Lobstershell
desc:
A large shell from a King
Lobster that was used as
bait. Very rare.

name: Giant Lobstershell
desc:
A large shell from a King
Lobster that was used as
bait. Very rare.

name: Cephalos Scale
desc:
A sand wyvern scale. Its
color is a brilliant blue.
Retains moisture.

name: Cephalos Scale+
desc:
High-quality sand wyvern
scale. It absorbs moisture,
leaving it glowing blue.

name: Cephalos Shard
desc:
A thick scale packed with
moisture, giving it a weird
texture hunters go for.

name: Cephalos Fin
desc:
A sand wyvern fin. It
isn't poisonous, but it's
very sharp.

name: Cephalos Fin+
desc:
A quality fin that is
sharper than other
comparable samples.

name: Cephalos Grandfin
desc:
A high-quality Cephalos fin.
Much sharper than your
run-of-the-mill fin.

name: Cephalos Fang
desc:
The fang of a Cephalos, which
are known for their rows of
jagged and razor-sharp teeth.

name: Cephalos Fang+
desc:
A sharp row of teeth made
for sinking deep into prey.

name: Cephalos Hardfang
desc:
An evolved fang. Strong and
sharp enough to chew right
through a Carapaceon.

name: Plesioth Scale+
desc:
A high-grade Plesioth scale
with a lapis lazuli glow.
It shines even when dry.

name: Plesioth Shard
desc:
A thick Plesioth scale with
a lapis lazuli glow. It fends
off claw and fang attacks.

name: Plesioth Fin+
desc:
A radiant Plesioth fin. Below
the surface lie sharp barbs
with a deadly neurotoxin.

name: Plesioth Grandfin
desc:
The finest and most lovely of
all Plesioth fins. Produces
top-class armor when forged.

name: Plesioth Fang+
desc:
A finely honed Plesioth Fang.
Sharp enough to shatter the
shells of small Carapaceons.

name: Plesioth Hardfang
desc:
A powerful, highly-developed
Plesioth Fang. It can crush
large Carapaceons with ease.

name: Plesioth Webbing
desc:
Difficult to forge with, but
its water-retention properties
make it popular as armor lining.

name: Hrd Ples Webbing
desc:
Stronger than normal webbing,
and just as water-retentive.
Ideal for lining armor.

name: Plesioth Head
desc:
A surprisingly hard head prized
as armor material. Might make
for a great party gag, too.

name: Uber Plesio Head
desc:
A frighteningly hard head found
on a select few Plesioth. Among
the very best in armor materials.

name: Hyper Plesioth Scale
desc:
Darker than normal Plesioth
scales, this Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Plesioth Shard
desc:
Darker than normal Plesioth
scales, this tough Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Lavasioth Scale+
desc:
A superior Lavasioth scale.
The encrusted lava leaves
behind a brilliant gold sheen.

name: Lavasioth Shard
desc:
A thick Lavasioth scale. Under
the encrusted lava lies a
golden treasure.

name: Lavasioth Carapace
desc:
Lavasioth carapace encrusted
with rare hardened minerals,
making for excellent armor.

name: Lavasioth Cortex
desc:
Heavy Lavasioth carapace
covered in hardened minerals,
making for excellent armor.

name: Lavasioth Fang+
desc:
A sharp fang from a Lavasioth.
Its size is unusual for a
Piscine Wyvern.

name: Lavasioth Hardfang
desc:
A hard, sharp Lavasioth
fang. Its size is unusual
for a Piscine Wyvern.

name: Lavasioth Fin+
desc:
A high-quality fin that has been
sharpened into a virtual weapon
due to the lava's heat.

name: Lavasioth Grandfin
desc:
A top-grade Lavasioth fin.
The magma has endowed it
with an extremely sharp edge.

name: Hyper Lavasioth Scale
desc:
Darker than normal Lavasioth
scales, this Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Lavasioth Shard
desc:
Darker than normal Lavasioth
scales, this tough Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hydro Hide
desc:
Hide that is highly resistant
to Water. Don't expect it to
sell for much.

name: Hydro Hide+
desc:
The durable hide of an aquatic
monster. Highly Water-resistant,
and in especially good shape.

name: Hydro Piel
desc:
This thick, durable hide of an
aquatic monster is highly
water-resistant.

name: Immature Sponge
desc:
A sponge from the sea that is
not fully developed. Demand
for it is high in general.

name: Spongy Hide
desc:
Hide that is highly resistant
to Water. Don't expect it to
sell for much.

name: Spongy Hide+
desc:
High-grade elastic hide that
boasts a remarkable ability
to retain water.

name: Spongy Piel
desc:
Nearly flawless elastic hide
that retains water better
than any comparable item.

name: R.Ludroth Scale
desc:
A small scale that enables
graceful movement. Several are
needed to forge equipment.

name: R.Ludroth Scale+
desc:
A large, strong scale from a
Royal Ludroth. It reflects light
in every direction.

name: R.Ludroth Shard
desc:
The ultimate Royal Ludroth
scale. A rainbow of colors
shimmer on its surface.

name: R.Ludroth Claw
desc:
A claw from a Royal Ludroth.
Adapted better to movement
than to attacking.

name: R.Ludroth Claw+
desc:
A sharp, pointed Royal Ludroth
claw. It plunges deep into the
earth with each step taken.

name: R.Ludroth Talon
desc:
A menacingly powerful Royal
Ludroth claw that enables it
to charge through any terrain.

name: R.Ludroth Crest
R.Ludroth Crest+
desc:
A proud, strong crest befitting
a pack leader. Its sharp horns
shine magnificently.

name: Chic Crest
desc:
A proud, strong crest befitting
a pack leader. Its sharp horns
shine magnificently.

name: R.Ludroth Tail
desc:
The finned tail of a Royal
Ludroth, used by fishermen
for their boats.

name: R.Ludroth Lash
desc:
A superior tail from a Royal
Ludroth. Its strength shows it
