was honed in harsh conditions.

name: Hyper R.Ludroth Scale
desc:
Darker than normal R.Ludroth
scales, this Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper R.Ludroth Shard
desc:
Darker than normal R.Ludroth
scales, this tough Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Nibelsnarf Shell
desc:
A shell piece from a Nibelsnarf.
Its great strength and hornlike
bulges produce unique gear.

name: Nibel Carapace
desc:
A rigid Nibelsnarf carapace.
Hard to forge, but the resulting
equipment is worth the effort.

name: Nibelsnarf Cortex
desc:
A heavy Nibelsnarf cortex.
Difficult to forge, but capable
of producing impressive gear.

name: Nibelsnarf Hide
desc:
Hide from a Nibelsnarf. Many are
surprised by its bright colors,
in contrast to the outer shell.

name: Nibelsnarf Hide+
desc:
Quality Nibelsnarf hide often
used as lining for armor. Strong
enough to withstand the desert.

name: Nibelsnarf Piel
desc:
Honed by exposure to sand, this
top-quality Nibelsnarf hide boasts
great strength and elasticity.

name: Nibelsnarf Claw
desc:
Nibelsnarf claws have evolved
to be able to quickly and easily
burrow through desert sand.

name: Nibelsnarf Claw+
desc:
A bold, firm Nibelsnarf claw.
Ideal as material for crafting
superior equipment parts.

name: Nibelsnarf Talon
desc:
The sharp talon of a Nibelsnarf,
perfectly adapted to burrow
through sand. A quality item.

name: Nibelsnarf Scalp
desc:
A part of the skull that holds
various organs. The useful bits
must be cut out carefully.

name: Nibelsnarf Crown
desc:
The heavy scalp of a Nibelsnarf
is difficult to work with but it's an
extremely versatile material

name: Vivid Fluid
desc:
A fluid which helps retain water
in a Nibelsnarf and allows the
beast to thrive in the desert.

name: Brilliant Fluid
desc:
A fluid with strong water-
retention ability. Improves
equipment performance.

name: Dazzling Fluid
desc:
A sparkling fluid with impressive
water-retention ability. Improves
equipment performance and style.

name: Hyper Nibelsnarf Shell
desc:
Darker than normal
Nibelsnarf shell, this Hyper
shell emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Nibelsnarf Cortex
desc:
Darker than normal Nibelsnarf
shell, this tough Hyper shell emits
an ominous glow.

name: Lagiacrus Hide
desc:
Not especially durable, but
soft and workable. Use it to
forge valuable leatherware.

name: Lagiacrus Hide+
desc:
A fine hide taken from a
Lagiacrus. It's quite strong
and immensely flexible.

name: Lagiacrus Piel
desc:
The strong, flexible hide of
a Lagiacrus. Used in expensive
leatherwear, among other items.

name: Lagiacrus Scale
desc:
A supple scale that turns
myriad shades of blue in the
light. In high demand.

name: Lagiacrus Scale+
desc:
A fine example of a supple
Lagiacrus Scale. Its beauty
is truly breathtaking.

name: Lagiacrus Shard
desc:
The ultimate specimen of
Lagiacrus Scale. Special skills
are required to craft with it.

name: Shell Shocker
desc:
This shell is actually used
to release electricity, not
generate it. Safe to handle.

name: Shell Shocker+
desc:
A superior shell found only on
certain Lagiacrus. Its structure
permits greater electric output.

name: Deathly Shocker
desc:
A thick shell found on a select
few Lagiacrus. It releases huge
bolts of electricity.

name: Lagiacrus Horn
desc:
The power of Lagiacrus horns
has been sung of for ages.
In high demand.

name: Lagiacrus Horn+
desc:
A fine horn taken from a strong
Lagiacrus. A horn like this is sure
to catch people's attention.

name: Lagia Hardhorn
desc:
A fine horn from an especially
strong Lagiacrus. So unique,
it's almost legendary.

name: Lagiacrus Tail
desc:
Not only do these serve for
weaponcraft, they also wind
up on Moga dinner plates.

name: Lagiacrus Flail
desc:
Not only do these serve for
weaponcraft, they also wind
up on Moga dinner plates.

name: Lagiacrus Claw
desc:
A sharp claw that grows on
the fin. Not pretty enough
to command good money.

name: Lagiacrus Claw+
desc:
A very sharp claw found on
certain Lagiacrus. Its mundane
appearance belies its strength.

name: Lagiacrus Talon
desc:
A thick talon found on only a
select few Lagiacrus. Adds both
power and dignity to weapons.

name: Lagiacrus Plate
desc:
The largest and most prized
of Lagiacrus scales. Boosts
the efficacy of equipment.

name: Lagiacrus Sapphire
desc:
A gem only rarely plucked
from a Lagiacrus. Craft with
it to boost Resistances.

name: Lagiacrus Mantle
desc:
A valuable azure scale found on
select Lagiacrus. Said to greatly
boost equipment performance.

name: Hyper Lagiacrus Hide
desc:
Darker than normal Lagiacrus
hide, this Hyper hide
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Lagiacrus Piel
desc:
Darker than normal Lagiacrus
hide, this Hyper hide
emits an ominous glow.

name: Uroktor Scale
desc:
A volcanic monster's scale.
Highly resistant to Fire,
but doesn't sell for much.

name: Uroktor Scale+
desc:
A high-quality Uroktor scale.
Heat-resistant, bright crimson,
and popular with the ladies.

name: Uroktor Shard
desc:
A superior-quality Uroktor scale.
Heat-resistant, bright crimson,
and popular with the ladies.

name: Agnaktor Scale
desc:
A scale so bright that it
looks like it's on fire. Not
worth very much, though.

name: Agnaktor Carapace
desc:
Sturdier and more heat-resistant
than the Shell. It produces a
vivid red color when crafted.

name: Agnaktor Cortex
desc:
The rigid cortex of an Agnaktor.
Highly heat-resistant, creates
bright red items when forged.

name: Agnaktor Hide+
desc:
Precious, high-quality Agnaktor
hide tempered by frequent
exposure to magma.

name: Agnaktor Piel
desc:
Top-quality Agnaktor hide
with fantastic heat resistance.
Thick but sufficiently supple.

name: Agnaktor Claw+
desc:
A claw sharpened by magma so
hot it can melt rock. Almost as
strong as a volcano itself.

name: Agnaktor Talon
desc:
A powerful talon found only on
certain Agnaktor. Even magma
cowers before it.

name: Agnaktor Fin+
desc:
An Agnaktor fin with an elegant
dappled pattern. Apparently a
popular item with collectors.

name: Agnaktor Grandfin
desc:
A premium fin lovely enough to
have been painted by an artist.
Behold the mystery of nature!

name: Agnaktor Beak
desc:
An Agnaktor's distinguishing
beak, which allows it to
tunnel beneath the earth.

name: Agnaktor Tail
desc:
A tail carved from an
Agnaktor. The going price is
low due to lack of demand.

name: Scalding Pleura+
desc:
A chestplate made from ore fusing
together over a number of years.
Won't melt, despite the heat.

name: Scorching Pleura
desc:
A burning chestplate tempered
for ages. The various ores fused
within are the key to its strength.

name: Hyper Agnaktor Shell
desc:
Darker than normal Agnaktor
shell, this Hyper shell
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Agnaktor Cortex
desc:
Darker than normal Agnaktor
shell, this tough Hyper shell
emits an ominous glow.

name: Tetsucabra Scale
desc:
A scale with red and black
patches that blends in well
with cavern environments.

name: Tetsucabra Scale+
desc:
A fine red-and-black scale.
The top pick for artisans who
want the time-hardened best.

name: Tetsucabra Shard
desc:
A thick, red-and-black scale
so hard that people justi-
fiably mistake it for rock.

name: Tetsucabra Shell
desc:
A flexible yet hard rubber-
like shell. In high demand
as an armor forging material.

name: Tetsucabra Carapace
desc:
A flexible, highly durable
shell that makes comfortable
and easy-to-move-in armor.

name: Tetsucabra Cortex
desc:
Tough, rubbery plating that
is difficult to break. A
popular equipment material.

name: Tetsucabra Claw
desc:
A powerful claw that can
pulverize rock. Short, but
worth the effort to obtain.

name: Tetsucabra Claw+
desc:
A powerful claw that can
pulverize rock. Creates
scratch-proof equipment.

name: Tetsucabra Hardclaw
desc:
A powerful claw that can
smash through boulders.
Challenging to forge with.

name: Tetsucabra Tusks
desc:
A giant, shovel-like jaw,
complete with tusks used for
attacking and movement.

name: Tetsucabra Tusks+
desc:
A jaw with oversized tusks.
Recent finds reveal damaged
tusks grow back even harder.

name: Tetsucabra Gnawrl
desc:
A fang that grows like a
mighty tree. Lost fangs are
replaced by stronger ones.

name: Dignified Skull
desc:
A distinctly warped skull
that is far more durable
than normal bone.

name: Vicious Visage
desc:
A skull with opposing fangs
and a sturdy lower jaw whose
evolution warrants study.

name: Paddock Oil
desc:
A mysterious oil found only
in nature. Used at the Smithy
as a lubricant and additive.

name: Paddock Oil+
desc:
A mysterious oil found only
in nature. Purer oil yields
higher forge temperatures.

name: Paddock Cream
desc:
A mysterious oil found only
in nature. Used at the Smithy
as a lubricant and additive.

name: Hyper Tetsu. Scale
desc:
Darker than normal
Tetsucabra scales, this Hyper
scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Tetsu. Shard
desc:
Darker than normal Tetsucabra
scales, this tough Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Drilltusk Scale
desc:
A Drilltusk Tetsucabra scale.
It's hard and features a
unique red and blue pattern.

name: Drilltusk Scale+
desc:
A hard scale of a Drilltusk
Tetsucabra. It's sharp and
features a unique pattern.

name: Drilltusk Shard
desc:
A thick scale of a Drilltusk
Tetsucabra. Unbelievably hard
with a unique pattern.

name: Drilltusk Shell
desc:
A Drilltusk Tetsucabra shell.
It's quite hard and has a
unique red and blue pattern.

name: Drilltusk Carapace
desc:
A Drilltusk Tetsucabra
carapace. Its thickness
makes it quite hard.

name: Drilltusk Cortex
desc:
An unbelievably tough Drilltusk
Tetsucabra carapace with a
unique pattern.

name: Drilltusk Tusk
desc:
The tusk of a Drilltusk
Tetsucabra. Used to dig
up large boulders.

name: Drilltusk Tusk+
desc:
A massive Drilltusk Tetsucabra
tusk. An extension of its
jaw and its brutality.

name: Drilltusk Gnawrl
desc:
A giant fang that is hard and
sharp enough to grind a
mountain to powder.

name: Sharqskin Scale
desc:
Zamite skin that feels
smooth or coarse depending
on which way you rub it.

name: Meaty Hide+
desc:
The hide from the underbelly
of a Zamite. The most
elastic samples are costly.

name: Zamtrios Hide+
desc:
A fine, stretchy hide. It
tears only after new, harder
skin has formed underneath.

name: Zamtrios Piel
desc:
A thick, elastic hide with
high Ice resistance. Like
wearing winter, yet warm.

name: Zamtrios Scale+
desc:
A fine scale that functions
like sandpaper. Used to hone
the edges of weapons.

name: Zamtrios Shard
desc:
One of many thick, razor-
sharp scales that shred any
foolish enough to touch.

name: Zamtrios Fin+
desc:
A quality dorsal fin that's
in high demand. Big fins go
for a premium at market.

name: Zamtrios Grandfin
desc:
A huge dorsal fin that cuts
gracefully through the ice.
Loved by artisans and hunters.

name: Zamtrios Sawtooth
desc:
A blunt tooth that slowly
and painfully tears through
the Zamtrios's prey.

name: Zamtrios Sawtooth+
desc:
Triangular, saw-like teeth
for biting and crushing.
Will grow back if pulled out.

name: Zamtrios Tailblade
desc:
A razor-sharp tail that does
as well as any axe if one
brings it down hard.

name: Zamtrios Tailbrand
desc:
A large tail whose meaty
swings can knock prey out
with a single lash.

name: Hyper Zamtrios Hide
desc:
Darker than normal Zamtrios
hide, this Hyper hide
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Zamtrios Piel
desc:
Darker than normal Zamtrios
hide, this tough Hyper hide
emits an ominous glow.

name: Najarala Shell
desc:
A shell that grows both
large and small -- whatever
won't impede movement.

name: Najarala Ampsounder
desc:
A special plate that ampli-
fies sound, getting messages
across loud and clear.

name: Najarala Carapace
desc:
A long shell that covers
the Najarala and may
have evolved from a scale.

name: Najarala Cortex
desc:
The hardest part of the
carapace. Multiple, layered
plates provide durability.

name: Najarala Hide
desc:
Comparatively flexible hide
found under the shell and on
the underbelly.

name: Najarala Hide+
desc:
A fine, silky-smooth hide
that sells well at market as
a top-class material.

name: Najarala Piel
desc:
The finest of Najarala
hides. Often used in all
kinds of leatherwork.

name: Najarala Marrow
desc:
Marrow known to cause
paralysis if handled
improperly.

name: Najarala Medulla
desc:
A mass of tissue used as a
coagulant in all manner of
crafts.

name: Najarala Sounder
desc:
A Najarala shell with
unique acoustic properties
that amplify sound.

name: Najarala Sounder+
desc:
A shell with unique acoustic
properties. Fragile and a
real challenge to work with.

name: Najarala Fang
desc:
A fang containing an organ
that induces neurogenic
paralysis.

name: Chilling Beak
desc:
The Najarala's bird-like
beak, which it uses to
instantaneously seize prey.

name: Heart-stopping Beak
desc:
The Najarala's unique beak.
Fangs inside it neutralize
prey in ghastly fashion.

name: Hyper Najarala Shell
desc:
Darker than normal Najarala
shell, this Hyper shell
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Najarala Cortex
desc:
Darker than normal Najarala
shell, this tough Hyper shell
emits an ominous glow.

name: Black Pearl
desc:
A pearl with a black glow.
Fetches a high price.

name: Fine Black Pearl
desc:
Largest and most beautiful of
all black pearls. Very valuable
and hard to find.

name: Wyvern Scalp
desc:
A Carapaceon shell made
from a wyvern's skull.

name: Heavy Wyvern Scalp
desc:
A Carapaceon shell made
from a wyvern's skull that
is harder than normal.

name: Decayed Crimson Horn
desc:
A red horn from a shelled
monster. Despite the decay, it
remains extremely durable.

name: Timeworn Crimson Horn
desc:
A faded horn which has been
weathered over time but still
has some value.

name: Sm. Hermitaur Shell
desc:
A piece of bone from a giant
Carapaceon. Its small form
means it has limited use.

name: Tiny Hermitaur Shell
desc:
A tiny piece of bone from a giant
Carapaceon. It may be small but
its value depends on its use.

name: Hermitaur Shell
desc:
A large piece of exoskeleton
that's surprisingly light and
easy to use in crafting.

name: Hermitaur Carapace
desc:
The hard carapace of a
Daimyo Hermitaur. Harder
than shell to work.

name: Hermitaur Cortex
desc:
A Daimyo Hermitaur's tough
bone shell. Its thickness
makes for strong armor.

name: Hermitaur Claw
desc:
A giant claw from a Daimyo
Hermitaur. The sharp claw
can slice through rock.

name: Hermitaur Claw+
desc:
Sharp claw from a Daimyo
Hermitaur. As hard as metal.

name: Hermitaur Hardclaw
desc:
A Daimyo Hermitaur's hard
claw. Tough enough to fortify
castles.

name: Hyper Hermitaur Scale
desc:
Darker than normal Hermitaur
scales, this Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Hermitaur Cortex
desc:
Darker than normal Hermitaur
scales, this tough Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Stonefist Shell
desc:
The shell from a Stonefist
Hermitaur. It has grown hard
and dark over its many years.

name: Stonefist Carapace
desc:
A hardened Stonefist Hermitaur
shell. It has grown hard and
dark over its many years.

name: Stonefist Cortex
desc:
A very hard Stonefist Hermitaur
shell. It has grown hard and
dark over its many years.

name: Stonefist Claw
desc:
A claw taken from a Stonefist
Hermitaur. It has grown hard
and dark over its many years.

name: Stonefist Claw+
desc:
A sharp claw from a Stonefist
Hermitaur. It has grown hard
and dark over its many years.

name: Stonefist Talon
desc:
A very sharp Stonefist Hermitaur
claw. It has grown hard and
dark over its many years.

name: Small Ceanataur Shell
desc:
A piece of a giant Ceanataur
Shell. Lighter than it
looks and easy to craft.

name: Ceanataur Shell
desc:
A giant Shogun Ceanataur
Shell. Has a distinctive
color and shape.

name: Ceanataur Carapace
desc:
Harder than a Ceanataur
Shell, this carapace is
harder to work with.

name: Ceanataur Cortex
desc:
Thicker than normal Ceanataur
bone, this high quality material
demands a master craftsman.

name: Ceanataur Leg
desc:
A Shogun Ceanataur leg.
Incredibly strong to support
the beast's massive body.

name: Ceanataur Leg+
desc:
A giant Shogun Ceanataur leg.
Extremely strong to support
the beast's massive body.

name: Heavy Ceanataur Leg
desc:
An extremely thick Shogun
Ceanataur leg. The shape is
perfect for making weapons.

name: Ceanataur Claw
desc:
A giant Shogun Ceanataur
claw. Those who fall in its
path pay a dear price.

name: Ceanataur Claw+
desc:
The sharp claw of a giant
Shogun Ceanataur. It's a
true menace to hunters.

name: Ceanataur Hardclaw
desc:
A top quality claw from a giant
Shogun Ceanataur. Reserved
for use in the finest equipment.

name: Hyper Ceanataur Shell
desc:
Darker than normal Ceanataur
shell, this Hyper shell
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Ceanataur Crtx
desc:
Darker than normal Ceanataur
shell, this tough Hyper shell
emits an ominous glow.

name: Heavy Rustrazor Scalp
desc:
A thick and durable skull bone
from inside a Rustrazor Ceanataur.

name: Rustrazor Cortex
desc:
A thick and durable Rustrazor
Ceanataur carapace used only
by the finest craftsmen.

name: Rustrazor Hardclaw
desc:
A hard Rustrazor Ceanataur
claw that possesses unrivaled
beauty and toughness.

name: Nerscylla Carapace
desc:
A white shell popular with
women and treated as a top-
class material.

name: Nerscylla Cortex
desc:
Thick, opalescent plating
with nary a scratch. Trades
at an extremely high price.

name: Nerscylla Shear
desc:
A venomous fang that expands
and contracts at will.
Beware its lethal poison!

name: Nerscylla Scishorn
desc:
Stretching, poison-laden
fangs found in a Nerscylla's
mouth. Perfect for weapons.

name: Nerscylla Sharpclaw
desc:
One of the Nerscylla's sharp
claws. Prey attacked by
this never survives.

name: Nerscylla Hardclaw
desc:
An impressive specimen used
once its web-weaving owner
has danced prey in circles.

name: Nerscylla Spike+
desc:
A dorsal spike that is
prized for its lethal poison
sac more than its sharpness.

name: Nerscylla Surspike
desc:
Spikes from the back whose
concentrated poison requires
very careful handling.

name: Hyper Nerscylla Cortex
desc:
Darker than normal Nerscylla
shell, this tough Hyper Shell
emits an ominous glow.

name: Seltas Carapace
desc:
A hard piece of exoskeleton
whose smooth surface reduces
air resistance while flying.

name: Seltas Cortex
desc:
A thick but shockingly light
piece of exoskeleton made of
shock-resistant layers.

name: Seltas Innerwing
desc:
A vital organ for the flying
Seltas. In high demand
as a household material.

name: Seltas Razorwing
desc:
Fluid-filled wings that
beat at high speeds to
grant the Seltas flight.

name: Seltas Horn+
desc:
A sharp horn popular with
artisans because, frankly,
it's pretty deadly as is.

name: Seltas Hardhorn
desc:
A vicious horn that the
Seltas sharpens on boulders
as if whetting a blade.

name: S.Queen Carapace
desc:
A hard piece of exoskeleton
that once made a Seltas
Queen a veritable fortress.

name: S.Queen Cortex
desc:
An especially thick,
iridescent carapace used in
impressive Decorations.

name: S.Queen Hardpectus
desc:
A hard shell from the chest.
Its non-slip surface exists
so males can mount easily.

name: S.Queen Pectus+
desc:
Especially thick chest
plating. Nearby gas holes
have given it an odd aroma.

name: S.Queen Sharpclaw
desc:
A claw with a non-slip
coating. Used mostly for
movement and tunneling.

name: S.Queen Hardclaw
desc:
A beefy Seltas Queen claw.
Dull, but its high durability
suits it for equipment.

name: S.Queen Jaw
desc:
A shell that serves as the
Seltas Queen's jaw. Used to
expel potent breath.

name: S.Queen Maw
desc:
A large jaw that opens
laterally to chew through
meals with ease.

name: S.Queen Crescent
desc:
Moon-shaped shears that
double as a tail. Used for
defense when foes approach.

name: S.Queen Moonlash
desc:
Large shears from the tip of
the tail. Inspires servitude
from Seltas, fear in humans.

name: S.Queen Extract
desc:
A fluid that circulates
through the body. Acidifies
when it touches the air.

name: D.S.QueenConcentrate
desc:
An abnormally secreted
substance acclaimed for its
use in Neopteron forging.

name: Hyper S.Queen Shell
desc:
Darker than normal S.Queen
shell, this Hyper shell
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper S.Queen Cortex
desc:
Darker than normal Seltas
Queen shell, this tough Hyper
shell emits an ominous glow.

name: Barroth Carapace
desc:
A Barroth's carapace coated
in multiple layers of mud,
making it quite rigid.

name: Barroth Cortex
desc:
A Barroth's cortex. Years'
worth of mud have hardened
it beyond all measure.

name: Barroth Ridge+
desc:
A thick, sturdy part of a Barroth
backplate. Mud and sunlight have
helped to harden it further.

name: Barroth Chine
desc:
The thickest part of a Barroth's
backplate. Mud, sun, and age
have made it rock-hard.

name: Barroth Claw+
desc:
A polished claw sharpened by
sand and dirt. It can dig through
even the toughest earth.

name: Barroth Talon
desc:
A strong claw found on only the
most formidable of Barroth. It
can easily dig through solid rock.

name: Barroth Scalp
desc:
This durable part of a
Barroth's skull is also the
hardest to remove.

name: Barroth Crown
desc:
The heavy scalp of a formidable
Barroth. As hard to remove
as it is durable.

name: Barroth Tail
desc:
Barroth tails aren't very
valuable, but the meat is
hailed as a delicacy.

name: Barroth Lash
desc:
A rigid tail carved from a
select few Barroth. Inexpensive,
but surprisingly versatile.

name: Fertile Mud
desc:
Mud that Barroth roll around
in. Nutrient-rich and great
for farming.

name: Hyper Barroth Cortex
desc:
Darker than normal Barroth
shell, this tough Hyper shell
emits an ominous glow.

name: Uragaan Scale
desc:
A hardened scale composed
of ore that gives off a faint
glow when exposed to light.

name: Uragaan Scale+
desc:
A strong scale formed by
layers and layers of ore. Its
hardness makes forging tricky.

name: Uragaan Shard
desc:
An impenetrable scale found on
certain Uragaan. Formed when
layers of hard ore bonded.

name: Uragaan Shell
desc:
This strong, sturdy piece of
exoskeleton makes armor that
looks dull but works great.

name: Uragaan Carapace
desc:
A hard Uragaan carapace.
Its rigidity makes it quite
a challenge to remove.

name: Uragaan Cortex
desc:
An especially hard Uragaan
cortex. Crafting with it can be
a trying task, to say the least.

name: Uragaan Jaw
desc:
A crooked Uragaan jaw.
Coated with melted minerals
that have hardened over time.

name: Uragaan Jaw+
desc:
An exceptionally heavy Uragaan
jaw. Its destructive power comes
from a makeup of dense ore.

name: Uragaan Scute
desc:
Even more heat resistant
than the Shell, this is said
to protect sensitive organs.

name: Uragaan Scute+
desc:
A highly heat-resistant Uragaan
scute. Its thermal insulation
promises new armor possibilities.

name: Uragaan Marrow
desc:
Hard-to-obtain bone marrow
used for special crafts as
well as medicinal purposes.

name: Uragaan Ruby
desc:
A precious Uragaan gem. Prized
for its strengthening ability
during the forging process.

name: Uragaan Pallium
desc:
A legendary Uragaan shell.
Those who craft it rule the
earth and seize the sky.

name: Hyper Uragaan Scale
desc:
Darker than normal Uragaan
scales, this Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Uragaan Shard
desc:
Darker than normal Uragaan
scales, this tough Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Crystalbeard Scale
desc:
A Crystalbeard Uragaan scale.
Contains unique ores that
make it shine bright.

name: Crystalbeard Scale+
desc:
A high-quality Crystalbeard
Uragaan scale. Contains unique
ores that make it shine bright.

name: Crystalbeard Shard
desc:
An exquisite Crystalbeard
Uragaan scale. Has exceptional
shock-absorbing ability.

name: Crystalbeard Jaw
desc:
The jaw from a Crystalbeard
Uragaan. Contains unique ores
that make it shine bright.

name: Crystalbeard Maw
desc:
A high-quality Crystalbeard
Uragaan jaw. Contains unique
ores that make it shine bright.

name: Crystalbeard Mandible
desc:
An exceptional Crystalbeard
Uragaan jaw. Contains so much
ore that it is dazzlingly bright.

name: Treasure Nugget
desc:
A stone shard taken from a
Crystalbeard Uragaan. Prized
for the rare minerals within it.

name: Large Treasure Nugget
desc:
A large stone shard taken from a
Crystalbeard Uragaan. Prized
for the rare minerals within it.

name: Brach Shell
desc:
A dark green Brachydios shell.
Glossy like obsidian, it adds a
refined beauty to crafted gear.

name: Brach Carapace
desc:
A hard Brachydios carapace.
Glossy like obsidian, it adds a
refined beauty to crafted gear.

name: Brach Cortex
desc:
Thick cortex of a Brachydios.
Its stoic beauty adds strength
and dignity to equipment.

name: Brach Ebonshell
desc:
An obsidian Brachydios brace.
Makes especially strong armor,
perhaps due to the slime mold.

name: Brach Ebonshell+
desc:
An obsidian shell from the
foreleg. It has evolved to
withstand slime blasts.

name: Fine Brach Ebonshell
desc:
A premium Brachydios brace.
The slime coating may contain
weird bacteria, so be careful.

name: Brach Scalp
desc:
The large, protruding scalp of
a Brachydios, covered in an
explosive green substance.

name: Brach Scalp+
desc:
A hard and sharp scalp piece
from a fierce Brachydios. Even
more explosive than usual.

name: Brach Crown
desc:
A large head projection that
continually produces potent
slime from within.

name: Brach Warhead
desc:
A skull that rage has turned
into something far worse.
The pinnacle of materials.

name: Mystery Slime
desc:
The explosive green substance
found on Brachydios monsters.
Handle with extreme care.

name: Glowing Slime
desc:
A highly volatile fluid used by
especially savage Brachydios.
Handle very carefully!

name: Flashpoint Slime
desc:
Red Brachydios slime at its
most volatile: right before
an all-or-nothing attack.

name: Brach Hammer
desc:
An arm that has crushed the
courage out of many a hunter.
Slime makes forging tricky.

name: Brach Pounder
desc:
A Brachydios arm that buried
countless foolhardy hunters.
It's covered in green slime.

name: Brach Pounder+
desc:
The arm of an especially angry
Brachydios. Strong and heavy,
as if made of iron.

name: Brach Obliterator
desc:
A violent mass that triggers
blasts well beyond anything
a Barrel Bomb L can do.

name: Brach Tail
desc:
While most focus on Brachydios's
arms, its tail is also strong.
Beware the explosive slime!

name: Brach Lash
desc:
A strong tail that hits like
a cudgel and smashes through
boulders like so much dust.

name: Brach Marrow
desc:
Stickier than normal marrow.
A top-class welding material,
if you're in the market.

name: Brach Gem
desc:
A rare gem from a Brachydios.
Perhaps the secret of its
dreadful slime is hidden inside?

name: Brach Pallium
desc:
A legendary Brachydios shell.
Those who craft it rule the
earth and seize the sky.

name: Immortal Reactor
desc:
A hard-to-obtain Brachydios
organ. Used to render slime
more volatile when in peril.

name: Hyper Brach Shell
desc:
Darker than normal Brachydios
shell, this Hyper shell emits
an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Brach Cortex
desc:
Darker than normal Brachydios
shell, this tough Hyper shell
emits an ominous glow.

name: Duram Carapace
desc:
A stiff Duramboros carapace.
It can withstand attacks like
an impenetrable aegis.

name: Duramboros Cortex
desc:
A Duramboros cortex. This
heavy, strong armor saps
an opponent's will to fight.

name: Hard Mossplate
desc:
A shell covered in moss. Not
only is it hard, the moss absorbs
the shock of physical blows.

name: Heavy Mossplate
desc:
A Duramboros cortex covered in
moss. Its weight and mossy shock
absorber make it impenetrable.

name: Duramboros Hump
desc:
The hump of a Duramboros's back.
The fatty skin produces sturdy,
pliable equipment when crafted.

name: Marbled Hump
desc:
A quality hump found on select
Duramboros. Currently being
researched as a possible delicacy.

name: Duram Tailcase+
desc:
A superior Duramboros tailcase.
Slices and crushes using sharp
shell and heavy bone.

name: Duram Hardtail
desc:
A rigid shell from a Duramboros's
tail. Powerful and heavy enough
to smash through mountains.

name: Duramboros Horn+
desc:
A rigid Duramboros horn.
Nothing in the world can stop
it during a vicious charge.

name: Duramboros Hardhorn
desc:
An incredibly hard Duramboros
horn that somehow manages to
amplify the monster's ferocity.

name: Duram Sacrum
desc:
A striking Duramboros sacrum.
Such tough, symmetrical bones
are considered rare materials.

name: Durambolite
desc:
Legendary gem rarely produced
inside a Duramboros's body.
Elegant, though gloomy.

name: Hyper Duram Shell
desc:
Darker than normal Duramboros
shell, this Hyper shell emits
an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Duram Cortex
desc:
Darker than normal Duramboros
shell, this tough Hyper shell emits
an ominous glow.

name: Flabby Hide
desc:
Finally useable as a material
thanks to recent advances.
Has mysterious properties.

name: Pearl Hide
desc:
The hide of a Khezu.
Its strange properties are
still not fully understood.

name: Pearl Glosshide
desc:
Top-quality Khezu hide. Hunters
must take caution not to be
enraptured by its luster.

name: Pale Bone
desc:
The rib bone from a Khezu.
Still has chunks of meat
attached.

name: Pale Steak
desc:
Fatty meat from a
Khezu. Looks tasty,
but cannot be eaten.

name: Khezu Special Cut
desc:
An extremely high-quality cut
of red Khezu flesh.
...Yuck.

name: Hyper Khezu Hide
desc:
Darker than normal Khezu
hide, this Hyper hide
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Khezu Glosshide
desc:
Darker than normal Khezu
hide, this tough Hyper hide
emits an ominous glow.

name: Nargacuga Scale
desc:
A scale from a Nargacuga.
The surface is covered with
the beast's black fur.

name: Nargacuga Scale+
desc:
A black Nargacuga scale.
Despite its hardness, it's
surprisingly light and smooth.

name: Nargacuga Shard
desc:
A tough, black Nargacuga scale.
Thicker than standard scales,
but still lightweight.

name: Nargacuga Blackfur
desc:
Black fur that grows on
scales. Covers the animal
in jet-black darkness.

name: Nargacuga Pelt+
desc:
Pitch-black fur from a
Nargacuga. It absorbs all light
and emits pure darkness.

name: Nargacuga Blackfur+
desc:
A Nargacuga's highly evolved
black fur. Glossy and resilient,
it fends off claws and fangs.

name: Nargacuga Tail
desc:
A Nargacuga's impressive tail.
Might be mistaken for a weapon
if seen out of context.

name: Nargacuga Lash
desc:
A top-flight Nargacuga tail.
An ideal crafting material due
to its flexibility and strength.

name: Narga Tailspike
desc:
A spiky scale from a Nargacuga
tail. It stands up when the
beast is enraged.

name: Narga Tailspear
desc:
A first-class spike from a
Nargacuga tail. Heavy and sharp,
it can be shockingly deadly.

name: Nargacuga Cutwing
desc:
Blade-like Nargacuga wing.
Evolved to cut down prey
on the fly.

name: Narga Razor
desc:
The large, sharp bladewing
of a Nargacuga. It can slice
through foes in a flash.

name: Nargacuga Cutwing+
desc:
A stronger Nargacuga cutwing.
Extra-hard, it can cleave foes
in twain with a single swing.

name: Nargacuga Fang
desc:
Although small, the jagged
placement of these fangs
increase their cutting ability.

name: Nargacuga Fang+
desc:
A Nargacuga's incredibly sharp
fang. Evolved to tear rather
than chew.

name: Nargacuga Hardfang
desc:
A highly developed Nargacuga
fang. Bold and sharp, it can
easily slice prey to pieces.

name: Nargacuga Marrow
desc:
Marrow as nimble as the
Nargacuga itself; requires
talent to properly harvest.

name: Narga Medulla
desc:
A Nargacuga's medulla. Merely
touching it causes extreme pain,
making crafting quite difficult.

name: Nargacuga Mantle
desc:
A legendary Nargacuga scale.
Those who craft it rule the
earth and seize the sky.

name: Hyper Narga Scale
desc:
Darker than normal Nargacuga
scales, this Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Narga Shard
desc:
Darker than normal Nargacuga
scales, this tough Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Silverwind Scale
desc:
A Silverwind Nargacuga scale.
Its lightness allows free and
swift movement.

name: Silverwind Scale+
desc:
Although extremely hard, this
scale's lightness allows free
and swift movement.

name: Silverwind Shard
desc:
A Silverwind Nargacuga scale.
Its quality is denoted by its
flexibility and strength.

name: Silverwind Blackfur
desc:
Black fur from a Silverwind
Nargacuga. Its lightness allows
swift and free movement.

name: Silverwind Blackfur+
desc:
Quality fur from a Silverwind
Nargacuga. Its lightness allows
swift and free movement.

name: Silverwind Blackpelage
desc:
Refined fur from a Silverwind
Nargacuga. Its lightness allows
swift and free movement.

name: Barioth Carapace
desc:
A Barioth carapace with an
impressive shine. Strongly
resembles an ice floe.

name: Barioth Cortex
desc:
A cortex from a formidable
Barioth. Surprisingly strong
and impressively lightweight.

name: Barioth Pelt+
desc:
A high-quality white pelt with
a lovely texture. Nobles use
it as a symbol of authority.

name: Barioth Thickfur
desc:
Top quality white fur from a
Barioth. It feels like being
wrapped in angel wings.

name: Barioth Claw+
desc:
A claw honed in the harsh Tundra
environment. It can take down
prey with a single swipe.

name: Barioth Talon
desc:
A strong, hard talon found on
select Barioth. It can slice
through hard shells like butter.

name: Amber Fang+
desc:
Amber tusks sharpened by
countless kills. They can smash
through gigantic ice blocks.

name: Amber Hardfang
desc:
A thick, heavy tusk found on
select Barioth. Strong enough
to shatter almost anything.

name: Barioth Spike
desc:
These come in many sizes and
assist the Barioth in
clinging to walls of ice.

name: Barioth Tail
desc:
Barioth tails are covered in
hard plate and surprisingly
tough to sever.

name: Barioth Lash
desc:
A top-quality Barioth Tail.
Covered in hard plate, it requires
considerable skill to remove.

name: Hyper Barioth Piel
desc:
Darker than normal Barioth
hide, this tough Hyper hide
emits an ominous glow.

name: Basarios Carapace
desc:
Harder than Basarios
shell, this material is
also known as Gravite.

name: Basarios Wing
desc:
The wing of a Basarios.
Very hard to work as a
material.

name: Basarios Tears
desc:
Faintly pink gems found
near the tear ducts of a
Basarios.

name: Basarios Cortex
desc:
A heavy Basarios shell
encrusted with quality ore.
Perfectly mimics a stone wall.

name: Basarios Fellwing
desc:
A top-grade Basarios wing. It's
not great for flying, but highly
sought after as material.

name: Basarios Pallium
desc:
A legendary Basarios shell.
Those who craft it rule
the earth and seize the sky.

name: Hyper Basarios Cortex
desc:
Darker than normal Basarios
shell, this tough Hyper shell
emits an ominous glow.

name: Gravios Carapace
desc:
Harder than Gravios Shell,
this material is also known
as Gravite.

name: Gravios Cortex
desc:
A stout outer shell, heavier
than a carapace. Also known
as Mediastinum.

name: Gravios Scalp
desc:
A part carved from the head
of a Gravios. Incredibly
hard to work with.

name: Gravios Crown
desc:
Robust head plating whose
splendid shapes are weapon-
worthy already.

name: Gravios Wing
desc:
A hefty-looking Gravios
wing. Its value is on the up
due to its uses in crafting.

name: Gravios Fellwing
desc:
A thick, heavy wing. The
distinct webbing once full
grown fetches high prices.

name: Gravios Medulla
desc:
This brain stem is a
precious but hard to
craft Gravios part.

name: Gravios Pallium
desc:
A legendary Gravios shell.
Those who craft it rule the
earth and seize the sky.

name: Hyper Gravios Cortex
desc:
Darker than normal Gravios
shell, this tough Hyper shell
emits an ominous glow.

name: Rathian Scale
desc:
The scale of a Rathian,
the mate of Rathalos.

name: Rathian Scale+
desc:
A superior Rathian scale.
Looks like a normal Rathian
scale, but is extremely hard.

name: Rathian Shard
desc:
A particularly thick Rathian
scale. Its large size proves
its owner's advanced age.

name: Rathian Shell
desc:
A shell piece comprised of
layered scales, making it
much harder than just one.

name: Rathian Carapace
desc:
A sturdy Rathian carapace.
Even harder than a normal
Rathian Shell.

name: Rathian Cortex
desc:
A Rathian shell that is heavier
than the carapace. Used to
reinforce parts of equipment.

name: Rathian Webbing
desc:
This heat-resistant
material is often
used as armor lining.

name: Rathian Weave
desc:
Excellent heat retention but
it's so difficult to work with that
it has a legendary reputation.

name: Rathian Spike
desc:
Needle-like hair found on
a Rathian's back and wings.
They contain poison.

name: Rathian Spike+
desc:
As sharp as the keenest
blade. It is longer and
sturdier than other spikes.

name: Rathian Surspike
desc:
Only a few of these superior
spikes grow on a Rathian. It is
both sharp and highly toxic.

name: Rathian Plate
desc:
A searing tail scale. Hard
to come by and as fiery as
the wyvern it came from.

name: Rathian Ruby
desc:
A rare, precious gem from
inside a wyvern. Almost
too nice to use.

name: Rathian Mantle
desc:
A legendary Rathian scale.
Those who craft it rule
the earth and seize the sky.

name: Hyper Rathian Scale
desc:
Darker than normal Rathian
scales, this Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Rathian Shard
desc:
Darker than normal Rathian
scales, this tough Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Dreadqueen Scale
desc:
A Dreadqueen Rathian scale.
Its deadly poison makes it too
dangerous to even touch.

name: Dreadqueen Scale+
desc:
A hardened Dreadqueen Rathian
scale. Its poison makes it
too dangerous to even touch.

name: Dreadqueen Shard
desc:
A hardened Dreadqueen Rathian
scale so poisonous that it can only
be handled by professionals.

name: Dreadqueen Shell
desc:
A Dreadqueen Rathian shell. Its
deadly poison makes it too
dangerous to even touch.

name: Dreadqueen Carapace
desc:
A Dreadqueen Rathian carapace.
Its deadly poison makes it too
dangerous to even touch.

name: Dreadqueen Cortex
desc:
A hardened Dreadqueen Rathian
carapace so poisonous that it can
only be handled by professionals.

name: G.Rathian Scale+
desc:
Scale carved from the body
of a Gold Rathian.
Brilliant, even at night.

name: G.Rathian Shard
desc:
A thick Gold Rathian scale unlike
anything seen before. Sunlight
gives it an almost sacred glow.

name: G.Rathian Carapace
desc:
A hard shell covered in
shining gold scales. As
gorgeous as a gold bar.

name: G.Rathian Cortex
desc:
A cortex carved from a Gold
Rathian. All who see it gasp
at its intense glow.

name: G.Rathian Spike+
desc:
A sharp, poison-tipped hair
strand from the Gold Rathian
that resembles a sword.

name: G.Rath Surspike
desc:
A poisonous spike found on Gold
Rathians in rare circumstances.
It can pierce through anything.

name: Hyper G.Rathian Scale
desc:
Darker than normal Gold
Rathian scales, this Hyper
scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper G.Rathian Shard
desc:
Darker than normal Gold Rathian
scales, this tough Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Rathalos Scale
desc:
A Rathalos scale. Wyvern scales
and shells such as this are
fundamental forging materials.

name: Rathalos Scale+
desc:
An extraordinarily durable
scale carved from the body
of a Rathalos.

name: Rathalos Shard
desc:
A Rathalos part made of several
overlapping scales. Its strength
is a natural wonder.

name: Rathalos Shell
desc:
A shell piece comprised of
layered scales, making it
much harder than just one.

name: Rathalos Carapace
desc:
A rigid Rathalos carapace.
Even harder than a normal
Rathalos Shell.

name: Rathalos Cortex
desc:
A robust Rathalos shell that
is harder and sturdier
than the carapace.

name: Rathalos Webbing
desc:
This heat-resistant
material is often
used as armor lining.

name: Rathalos Wing
desc:
A wing that has been removed.
Skilled artisans can craft it
into strong equipment.

name: Rathalos Fellwing
desc:
A top-grade Rathalos wing,
removed in full. Such majesty
befits the King of the Skies.

name: Rathalos Tail
desc:
The severed tail of a Rathalos.
It has any number of uses.

name: Rathalos Lash
desc:
Top-grade Rathalos tail. Strong
ones like this are precious, and
only used in select equipment.

name: Rathalos Plate
desc:
A searing tail scale. Hard
to come by and as fiery as
the wyvern it came from.

name: Rathalos Ruby
desc:
A rare, precious gem from
inside a wyvern. Almost
too nice to use.

name: Rathalos Mantle
desc:
A legendary Rathalos scale.
Those who craft it rule the
earth and seize the sky.

name: Hyper Rathalos Scale
desc:
Darker than normal Rathalos
scales, this Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Rathalos Shard
desc:
Darker than normal Rathalos
scales, this tough Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Dreadking Scale
desc:
A Dreadking Rathalos scale.
It remains red-hot. Not
recommended to touch.

name: Dreadking Scale+
desc:
A hardened Dreadking Rathalos
scale. It remains red-hot.
Not recommended to touch.

name: Dreadking Shard
desc:
A hardened Dreadking Rathalos
scale so red-hot, it should only
be handled by professionals.

name: Dreadking Shell
desc:
A Dreadking Rathalos shell.
It remains red-hot. Not
recommended to touch.

name: Dreadking Carapace
desc:
A hardened Dreadking Rathalos
shell. It remains red-hot.
Not recommended to touch.

name: Dreadking Cortex
desc:
A hardened Dreadking Rathalos
shell so red-hot, it should only
be handled by professionals.

name: S.Rathalos Scale+
desc:
Quality scale carved from
a Silver Rathalos. It
has a moon-like shine.

name: S.Rathalos Shard
desc:
A Silver Rathalos part made of
several overlapping scales.
Makes for a nice accessory.

name: S.Rathalos Carapace
desc:
Carapace carved from a
Silver Rathalos. The silver
scales have an icy shine.

name: S.Rath Cortex
desc:
A heavy Silver Rathalos cortex.
This legendary item shines like
moonlight, even in darkness.

name: S.Rathalos Tail
desc:
Severed tail of a Silver
Rathalos. Sells at a high
price due to its rarity.

name: S.Rath Lash
desc:
A top-grade Silver Rathalos
tail. Beauty like this is worth
far more than actual silver.

name: Hyper S.Rath. Scale
desc:
Darker than normal Silver
Rathalos scales, this Hyper
scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper S.Rath. Shard
desc:
Darker than normal Rathalos
scales, this tough Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Rath Wingtalon
desc:
A talon that grows on a wyvern's
wing. Break it off in battle and
you may just be rewarded.

name: Rath Wingtalon+
desc:
A powerful talon from a wyvern's
wing. Hard and sharp enough to
rend boulders like paper.

name: Rath Marrow
desc:
Recent advances allow this
marrow to be extracted. It
ignites on air contact.

name: Rath Medulla
desc:
Only recently extractable
thanks to advances in carving
techniques. Difficult to process.

name: Rath Gleam
desc:
A liquid produced only by a
rare species of fire wyverns.
It glows faintly in the dark.

name: Firegleam Dollop
desc:
A shining fluid produced
only in rare wyverns. Even
now, it continues to boil.

name: Zinogre Shell
desc:
A blue-green shell which
stores electricity and works
as a protective insulator.

name: Zinogre Carapace
desc:
The teal carapace of a Zinogre.
Its magnificence reveals the
futility of facing the monarch.

name: Zinogre Cortex
desc:
The teal cortex of a Zinogre.
The monarch's armor crushes
wills with its immense power.

name: Zinogre Shockfur
desc:
White fur that stores and
magnifies electricity, which
it retains even after carving.

name: Zinogre Electrofur
desc:
Zinogre fur said to store a
high amount of electricity.
Shines white from the charge.

name: Zinogre Electrofur+
desc:
Zinogre fur said to store an
endless amount of electricity.
Shines with intense light.

name: Zinogre Horn
desc:
The Zinogre's magnificent
horn, which sends most of
nature running for cover.

name: Zinogre Horn+
desc:
A pointed Zinogre horn. When
carved, it can be used to grant
equipment incomparable power.

name: Zinogre Hardhorn
desc:
A mighty Zinogre horn. None can
stand before its sky-shattering,
awe-inspiring power.

name: Zinogre Claw
desc:
A sharp and tremendously
powerful claw capable of
quickly dicing up prey.

name: Zinogre Claw+
desc:
A sharp, high voltage Zinogre
claw. Its electrified attacks
are truly brutal.

name: Zinogre Hardclaw
desc:
A rigid, high-voltage Zinogre
talon. Its electrified attacks
threaten all existence.

name: Zinogre Tail
desc:
The plate-covered tail of a
Zinogre. It wields deadly
force when swung.

name: Zinogre Lash
desc:
A superior Zinogre tail
that wields incomparable
destructive power.

name: Zinogre Shocker
desc:
The ocher shell that once
lined a Zinogre's body.
Contains conductive lipids.

name: Zinogre Shocker+
desc:
A Zinogre shell that stores and
releases electricity. Grants a
thunder god's power to gear.

name: Zinogre D-Shocker
desc:
A shell with electric power that
shames even lightning. Its effect
on forged equipment is vast.

name: Zinogre Plate
desc:
A rare and intimidating
trophy that seems to pulse
with residual fury.

name: Zinogre Jasper
desc:
A rare gem sometimes produced
inside a Zinogre's body. The
beast's power swells within.

name: Zinogre Skymerald
desc:
An extremely rare gem found
only in select Zinogres. Proof
of the overwhelming warrior.

name: Hyper Zinogre Shell
desc:
Darker than normal Zinogre
shell, this Hyper shell
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Zinogre Cortex
desc:
Darker than normal Zinogre
shell, this tough Hyper shell
emits an ominous glow.

name: Thunderlord Shell
desc:
A Thunderlord Zinogre shell.
Even on its own, it shines
a brilliant gold.

name: Thunderlord Carapace
desc:
A hardened Thunderlord Zinogre
shell. Even on its own, it
shines a brilliant gold.

name: Thunderlord Cortex
desc:
A tough Thunderlord Zinogre
shell. It shines even more
brilliantly than gold.

name: Thunderlord Shockfur
desc:
A Thunderlord Zinogre pelt.
Even on its own, it continues
to give off electricity.

name: Thunderlord Electrofur
desc:
A gold Thunderlord Zinogre pelt.
Even on its own, it continues
to give off electricity.

name: Thunderlord Boltfur
desc:
A fine Thunderlord Zinogre pelt
that keeps its charge, so care
should be taken when holding it.

name: Thunderlord Horn
desc:
A Thunderlord Zinogre horn.
Even on its own, it shines
a brilliant gold.

name: Thunderlord Horn+
desc:
A fine Thunderlord Zinogre
horn. Even on its own, it
shines a brilliant gold.

name: Thunderlord Gleamhorn
desc:
A high grade Thunderlord
Zinogre horn. It shines even
more brilliantly than gold.

name: Astalos Scale
desc:
An Astalos scale that
reflects sunlight, giving it
a rainbow-like appearance.

name: Astalos Scale+
desc:
A quality scale carved from
an Astalos. Looks tough, but
is actually quite flexible.

name: Astalos Shard
Astalos Shell
desc:
The spiny shell of an Astalos
that covers it like armor.
Try to keep a safe distance!

name: Astalos Shell+
desc:
An Astalos's tough, spiny shell.
Hard and sharp, it's a favored
material for armor.

name: Heavy Astalos Shell
desc:
The spiny shell of an Astalos
that covers it like armor.
Try to keep a safe distance!

name: Astalos Membrane
desc:
An Astalos wing membrane. It
glows when exposed to
electricity. Thin but tough.

name: Astalos Membrane+
desc:
Quality Astalos wing membrane.
Pulses green and continues to
conduct electricity.

name: Astalos Wingmembrane
desc:
High quality wing membrane.
Pulses green and continues to
conduct electricity.

name: Astalos Wingtalon
desc:
An Astalos wingtalon. Black,
but turns a beautiful green
when exposed to electricity.

name: Astalos Wingtalon+
desc:
A sharp Astalos wingtalon,
capable of cutting through
its prey in one fell swoop.

name: Astalos Wingripper
desc:
A sharp Astalos wingtalon,
capable of cutting through
its prey with just a touch.

name: Astalos Crest
desc:
Conductive material can be
harvested from an Astalos's
head when it's threatened.

name: Astalos Crest+
desc:
A highly conductive material
pulsing with electricity that
is harvested from an Astalos.

name: Heavy Astalos Crest+
desc:
A special highly-conductive
material pulsing with electricity
taken from an Astalos head.

name: Astalos Scissortail
desc:
The scissors-shaped tail of
an Astalos. It's able to store
large amounts of electricity.

name: Astalos Scissortailblade
desc:
The scissors-shaped tail of
an Astalos. Watch out for its
dangerously high voltage.

name: Electroscale
desc:
Highly conductive scale from
an Astalos. Its unique shape
is hard to work with.

name: Electroscale+
desc:
An Astalos scale that gene-
rates electricity, even after
being separated from its body.

name: Boltscale
desc:
An Astalos scale that bristles
with electricity, even after
being separated from its body.

name: Astalos Plate
desc:
A scale carved from an
Astalos. It glows a bright
green and is very rare.

name: Astalos Electrogem
desc:
A brilliant green gem found
inside an Astalos. It pulsates
with an intense energy.

name: Astalos Mantle
desc:
A legendary Astalos scale.
Those who craft it rule the
earth and seize the sky.

name: Hyper Astalos Scale
desc:
Darker than normal Astalos
scales, this Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Astalos Shard
desc:
Darker than normal Astalos
scales, this Hyper scale emits
a steady, ominous glow.

name: Boltreaver Shard
desc:
A Boltreaver Astalos scale,
whose rigidity and amazing
ductility make it highly coveted.

name: Heavy Boltreaver Shell
desc:
This Boltreaver Astalos shell
is so sharp it should only be
handled by professionals.

name: Boltreaver Electric Barb
desc:
A Boltreaver Astalos barb
that can withstand immense
electrical currents.

name: Gammoth Pelt
desc:
A pelt carved from a Gammoth.
It's very durable as well as
resistant to cold.

name: Gammoth Pelt+
desc:
A high-quality pelt from a
Gammoth. It absorbs physical
blows without losing durability.

name: Gammoth Fur
desc:
This fine Gammoth fur boasts
both weatherproof durability
and luxuriant suppleness.

name: Gammoth Shell
desc:
A shell from a Gammoth leg. It
is designed to adhere to snow,
and is utilized in armor joints.

name: Gammoth Carapace
desc:
An especially hard shell taken
from a Gammoth leg. It's used
to protect vulnerable areas.

name: Gammoth Cortex
desc:
The shock absorption qualities of
this tough Gammoth shell can
take a craftsman's breath away.

name: Gammoth Fang
desc:
A large fang taken from a
Gammoth. Valued for being
tough, yet still pliable.

name: Gammoth Fang+
desc:
An extremely hard and tough
Gammoth fang. Difficult to
work with, but versatile.

name: Gammoth Hardfang
desc:
This weighty Gammoth fang can
destroy an eye-opening array
of materials without a scratch.

name: Trunkspine
desc:
A spine taken from the trunk
of a Gammoth. Strong enough
to pierce the ground.

name: Trunkspine+
desc:
A hard spine taken from the trunk
of a Gammoth. So sharp it can be
used to drill through solid rock.

name: Gammoth Redfur
desc:
Thick fur made of hard, red
hair taken from the lengthy
mane of a Gammoth.

name: Snowclod
desc:
A clump of snow hardened by
the material secreted from a
Gammoth's leg.

name: Large Snowclod
desc:
A large clump of snow stuck
to a Gammoth's leg. It is very
hard and doesn't melt easily.

name: Giant Snowclod
desc:
A huge clump of the snow that
protects a Gammoth's legs.
It's surprisingly sturdy.

name: Gammoth Scalp
desc:
A shell from a Gammoth's
head. Difficult to work with,
but worth the effort.

name: Gammoth Ice Orb
desc:
A gem from inside a Gammoth.
Named for its ice-like clarity
and being as shiny as a jewel.

name: Gammoth Pallium
desc:
A legendary Gammoth shell.
Those who craft it rule the
earth and seize the sky.

name: Hyper Gammoth Fur
desc:
Darker than normal Gammoth
fur, this Hyper fur emits an
ominous glow.

name: Hyper Gammoth Fur X
desc:
Darker than normal Gammoth
fur, this Hyper fur emits a
steady, ominous glow.

name: Elderfrost Pelt
desc:
Hugely stout and supple to match,
this Elderfrost Gammoth pelt is a
great material to work with.

name: Elderfrost Cortex
desc:
This Elderfrost Gammoth shell
won't let anything or anyone
near you. Peerless strength.

name: Elderfrost Trunkspine
desc:
A spine taken from the trunk of
an Elderfrost Gammoth. Artisans
would kill to work with it.

name: Mizutsune Scale
desc:
A transparent Mizutsune scale.
Its irregular shape refracts
light into many bright colors.

name: Mizutsune Scale+
desc:
A quality Mizutsune scale.
Older scales polished over
time can be very valuable.

name: Mizutsune Shard
desc:
A top-quality Mizutsune scale.
Its glossy appearance belies a
surprising toughness.

name: Mizutsune Purplefur
desc:
The purple fur of a Mizutsune.
Stiff, but is soft as silk when
soaked with bubblefoam.

name: Mizutsune Purplefur+
desc:
High-quality purple fur.
More foam-absorbent than
its lighter counterpart.

name: Mizutsune Purplefell
desc:
Luxuriant purple fur of great
toughness. Works amazingly
with bubblefoam.

name: Mizutsune Claw
desc:
A claw that flies freely
through bubblefoam, allowing
it to be used as a spike.

name: Mizutsune Claw+
desc:
Friction-reducing bubblefoam
helps this deadly claw slice
through prey like sushi.

name: Mizutsune Hardclaw
desc:
A Mizutsune claw of unparalleled
hardness, able to pierce
any enemy.

name: Mizutsune Fin
desc:
A beautiful brocade-like fin.
Males have large fins that
turn red to match their mood.

name: Mizutsune Fin+
desc:
A high-quality fin. Bubble-
foam gives it an elegant
pattern prettier than dye.

name: Mizutsune Silkfin
desc:
A fin so beautiful it wouldn't look
out of place as a sacred raiment
in a ritual dance.

name: Mizutsune Tail
desc:
The flowing tail of a Mizutsune.
It's prized for its supple
fur and beautiful scales.

name: Purple Mizutsune Tail
desc:
This flowing Mizutsune tail whose
lush fur and gorgeous scales
make it a top dance accessory.

name: Bubblefoam
desc:
Fluid secreted by a Mizutsune.
Just a few drops can turn a
swamp into a bubble bath.

name: Bubblefoam+
desc:
The top layer of a Mizutsune's
fluid. It removes impurities and
is used in religious rituals.

name: Distilled Bubblefoam
desc:
The top layer of a Mizutsune's
fluid, strained and distilled to
the highest purity.

name: Mizutsune Plate
desc:
A very old scale present since
the creature's birth. It can even
create a rainbow from light.

name: Mizutsune Water Orb
desc:
A multicolored orb formed
from a crystalized Mizutsune
scale and bubblefoam.

name: Mizutsune Pallium
desc:
A legendary Mizutsune scale.
Those who craft it rule the
earth and seize the sky.

name: Hyper Mizutsune Scale
desc:
Darker than normal Mizutsune
scales, this Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Mizutsune Scale X
desc:
Darker than normal Mizutsune
scales, this Hyper scale
emits a steady, ominous glow.

name: Soulseer Shard
desc:
A Soulseer Mizutsune scale. Those
who gaze on its polished surface
will find their way once more.

name: Soulseer Purplehide
desc:
A beautiful Soulseer Mizutsune
pelt. One stroke of its soft fur
is enough to bring calm.

name: Soulseer Tail
desc:
Those who touch this Soulseer
Mizutsune tail are captivated by
its loveliness. A priceless article.

name: Glavenus Scale
desc:
A Glavenus scale. Along with
the shell, they cover
its body's vulnerable parts.

name: Glavenus Scale+
desc:
A quality scale taken from a
Glavenus. It possesses excellent
heat and damage resistance.

name: Glavenus Shard
desc:
A Glavenus scale whose heat
resistance and protection could
probably withstand hellfire.

name: Glavenus Shell
desc:
A shell covering the entire body
of a Glavenus. It easily deflects
all but the strongest blows.

name: Glavenus Carapace
desc:
The hard shell of a Glavenus. It
has been tempered many times
due to its high body heat.

name: Glavenus Cortex
desc:
The tough shell of a Glavenus.
When forged to its limit, it makes
completely impenetrable armor.

name: Glavenus Fang
desc:
A fang from a Glavenus.
Razor sharp, it makes a
formidable weapon.

name: Glavenus Fang+
desc:
Durable enough to withstand the
jaws of a Glavenus's pressure, this
fang can cut through anything.

name: Glavenus Hardfang
desc:
This Glavenus fang is so hard
and sharp that it can crunch
through anything unscathed.

name: Glavenus Pyroshell
desc:
A shell that resembles
flickering flames. Its heat
resistance is quite high.

name: Glavenus Pyroshell+
desc:
A shell that looks like a raging
inferno. The constant heat
makes it hard to work with.

name: Glavenus Hellshell
desc:
A shell that resembles flickering
flames. One touch will reduce
you to ash, so handle with care.

name: Glavenus Tail
desc:
The tailblade of a Glavenus.
Constant heating and cooling
have forged a sturdy blade.

name: Glavenus Tailedge
desc:
The tailblade of a Glavenus.
So sharp, anything in its path
will be cleaved in two.

name: Glavenus Tailpiece
desc:
A detached piece of a Glavenus
tail. Only a piece, but it'll
still cut through most swords.

name: Flaming Bursa
desc:
A furnace-like organ located in
the throat. It enables the beast
to breathe red-hot magma.

name: Solar Bursa
desc:
A highly developed flaming
bursa. Cotton-thin, but can
resist even white-hot magma.

name: Molten Bursa
desc:
A fully-developed bursa carved
from a strong Glavenus. Can't
even be lightly scorched, ever.

name: Glavenus Plate
desc:
A sharp scale that grows near
the Glavenus's tail, it has
the same role -- a short blade.

name: Glavenus Fire Orb
desc:
A red orb that grows within
a flaming bursa. One peek can
set even your soul aflame.

name: Glavenus Pallium
desc:
A legendary Glavenus scale.
Those who craft it rule the
earth and seize the sky.

name: Hyper Glavenus Scale
desc:
Darker than normal Glavenus
scales, this Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Glavenus Scale X
desc:
Darker than normal Glavenus
scales, this Hyper scale
emits a steady, ominous glow.

name: Hellblade Scale
desc:
A Hellblade Glavenus scale.
Explodes violently if not
handled with care.

name: Hellblade Scale+
desc:
A superior Hellblade Glavenus
scale. Explodes violently if
not handled with care.

name: Hellblade Shard
desc:
A Hellblade Glavenus scale. A
thoughtless slip with it will reduce
the surrounding land to rubble.

name: Hellblade Shell
desc:
A shell taken from a Hellblade
Glavenus. Explodes violently if
not handled with care.

name: Hellblade Carapace
desc:
A hard Hellblade Glavenus shell.
Explodes violently if not handled
with care.

name: Hellblade Cortex
desc:
A hard Hellblade Glavenus shell.
Handled carelessly, it can reduce
the world to eternal wasteland.

name: Hellblade Powder
desc:
Powder taken from a Hellblade
Glavenus. Explodes violently
if not handled with care.

name: Tigrex Scale
desc:
Scale from the incredibly
violent Tigrex. Incredibly
massive and sturdy.

name: Tigrex Scale+
desc:
A flawless Tigrex scale. Can
be fastened with others to
become harder than steel.

name: Tigrex Shard
desc:
A thick Tigrex scale. Made to
withstand both the searing heat
and the shivering cold.

name: Tigrex Shell
desc:
A hard Tigrex shell
capable of repelling any
impact. Extreme tenacity.

name: Tigrex Carapace
desc:
A material hardened by the
sands of time. Sharp edges
show the Tigrex's ferocity.

name: Tigrex Cortex
desc:
A heavy Tigrex shell. Even the
terrible forces of nature cannot
penetrate it.

name: Tigrex Tail
desc:
This flexible and strong
tail can make great
equipment.

name: Tigrex Lash
desc:
A top-grade tail from a violent
Tigrex. Requires a veteran
artisan's skill and experience.

name: Tigrex Claw
desc:
A vicious foreclaw unique to
the Tigrex. Other flying
wyverns do not have it.

name: Tigrex Claw+
desc:
A claw that time has
sharpened into a horrible
death sentence for prey.

name: Tigrex Hardclaw
desc:
A highly durable Tigrex claw.
Tempered by the flesh and
blood of its prey.

name: Tigrex Fang
desc:
A terrifying fang used to
crush prey. Makes all who
see it quiver in fear.

name: Tigrex Fang+
desc:
The sharp fang of a
Tigrex. These fangs can
cut any prey to shreds.

name: Tigrex Hardfang
desc:
A thick, large Tigrex fang that
tore prey into unrecognizable
pieces.

name: Tigrex Scalp
desc:
Part of the head of a violent
Tigrex. Looks terrifying, as
if it is still alive.

name: Tigrex Maw
desc:
The awe-inspiring jaws of
a Tigrex, ready to crush
both bone and spirit.

name: Tigrex Mantle
desc:
A phantasmal scale of a Tigrex.
Those who craft it rule the
earth and seize the sky.

name: Hyper Tigrex Scale
desc:
Darker than normal Tigrex
scales, this Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Tigrex Scale X
desc:
Darker than normal Tigrex
scales, this Hyper scale
emits a steady, ominous glow.

name: Grimclaw Scale
desc:
A Grimclaw Tigrex scale. Dark
and thickly layered. Features
exceptional hardness.

name: Grimclaw Scale+
desc:
A superior Grimclaw Tigrex scale.
A scale of the highest quality.

name: Grimclaw Shard
desc:
A scale from a Grimclaw Tigrex.
Even the dark inner layers are
exceptionally hard.

name: Grimclaw Shell
desc:
A Grimclaw Tigrex shell. You can
see the thick blue blood vessels
pulsating on its exterior.

name: Grimclaw Carapace
desc:
You can see the blue blood
vessels pulsating on the
exterior of the shell.

name: Grimclaw Cortex
desc:
You can see the blue blood
vessels pulsating violently
on the shell's exterior.

name: Grimclaw Talon
desc:
A talon from a Grimclaw Tigrex.
It's as frightening and deadly
as it looks.

name: Grimclaw Talon+
desc:
A quality talon from a Grimclaw
Tigrex. It's as frightening and
deadly as it looks.

name: Grimclaw Hardclaw
desc:
This high-quality Grimclaw
Tigrex claw is the embodiment
of ferocity.

name: Seregios Bladescale
desc:
A dangerous scale that opens
at the tip to viscerally
attack the beast's foes.

name: Seregios Slavescale
desc:
A sharp scale the Seregios
can make stand on end.
Gouges anything it touches.

name: Seregios Slavescale+
desc:
A sharp scale that stands on
end as its master angers and
rips prey to awful pieces.

name: Airblade Shard
desc:
A fragment from a Seregios's
Airblade. Despite its small size,
it shouldn't be underestimated.

name: Seregios Airblade
desc:
A blade shot from the body
and carried on the wind
toward unsuspecting hunters.

name: Seregios Airblade+
desc:
One of a seemingly limitless
supply of wild blades shot
at any who dare approach.

name: Seregios Talon
desc:
The hard and sharp talon of a
Seregios. It is capable of tearing
most armor to shreds.

name: Seregios Carver
desc:
Hooked hind leg talons that
tear through armor and flesh
without mercy.

name: Seregios Carver+
desc:
Hooked talons that strike
like lightning, sharp enough
to rend the very air.

name: Seregios Impaler
desc:
A spear-like tail covered
in blade-like scales. Capable
of truly horrific things.

name: Seregios Impaler+
desc:
A spear-like tail so hard
and sharp, it passes through
prey as if they were air.

name: Seregios Sunderer
desc:
The horn from a Seregios.
Sturdy yet agile as a blade,
it is perfect for crafting them.

name: Seregios Breacher
desc:
A sharp horn like a hefty
axe that, not surprisingly,
makes for fine equipment.

name: Seregios Breacher+
desc:
A sharp, robust horn with
ripples as lovely as those
in the most famed blades.

name: Seregios Wingtalon
desc:
A talon that grows on the wing
of a Seregios. Enables superior
flight and handling capabilities.

name: Seregios Scraper
desc:
A wing talon. Most attacks
come from the hind legs; the
wings serve to shift weight.

name: Seregios Scraper+
desc:
A sharp wing talon. This
fine specimen is as good a
material as a hindleg claw.

name: Seregios Dissenter
desc:
A single scale that points
defiantly in a different
direction from its brethren.

name: Seregios Lens
desc:
A rare pearl formed inside
the body. Said to reveal
invisible truths.

name: Hyper Seregios Scale
desc:
Darker than normal Seregios
scales, this Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Seregios Scale X
desc:
Darker than normal Seregios
scales, this Hyper scale emits
a steady, ominous glow.

name: Diablos Carapace
desc:
A sturdy Diablos carapace.
Even harder than a normal
Diablos Shell.

name: Diablos Cortex
desc:
The rigid cortex of a Diablos,
both harder and sturdier
than its carapace.

name: Diablos Ridge+
desc:
The hardest part of a
Diablos's backplate. Very
difficult to carve off.

name: Diablos Chine
desc:
Tough Diablos backplate,
strengthened by burning sands.
An ideal material for armor.

name: Twisted Horn
desc:
A twisted Diablos horn.
Used in this region for many
(less twisted) purposes.

name: Majestic Horn
desc:
A twisted Diablos horn in
great shape. Use it to make
more powerful weapons.

name: Diablos Hardhorn
desc:
An especially elegant Diablos
horn with almost perfect shape.
An extremely rare material.

name: Diablos Fang
desc:
A large, sturdy fang used in
everything from weapons
to ornaments.

name: Diablos Tailcase
desc:
An armored tailcase that
puts iron hammers to shame.
This material is a keeper.

name: Diablos Tailcase+
desc:
A tailcase heavy enough
to bend a steel hammer.
Unimaginably powerful.

name: Blos Medulla
desc:
A rare medulla.
Difficult to remove, but of
great interest to researchers.

name: Hyper Diablos Cortex
desc:
Darker than normal Diablos
shell, this Hyper shell emits
a steady, ominous glow.

name: Bloodbath Cortex
desc:
A Bloodbath Diablos hard outer
shell. It wears the scars of
previous battles with honor.

name: Bloodbath Chine
desc:
A Bloodbath Diablos carapace.
Tempered thoroughly by the
blows of brave warriors.

name: Bloodbath Grimhorn
desc:
A Bloodbath Diablos horn. Vile
enough to recall the tragedies
the beast has caused.

name: Gore Magala Scale
desc:
A black scale artisans fear
because of the ill fortune
said to surround it.

name: Gore Magala Scale+
desc:
A deep black scale that
seems to devour surrounding
light, not reflect it.

name: Gore Magala Shard
desc:
A quality scale whose jet
black, lusterless surface
bewitches unwary beholders.

name: Gore Magala Shell
desc:
The Gore Magala's outer
shell, said to eat the flesh
of half-hearted attackers.

name: Gore Magala Carapace
desc:
The Gore Magala's handsome
black suit of armor, said to
negate all blows.

name: Gore Magala Cortex
desc:
A heavy, dark carapace which
offers solid equipment, but
no guarantees of sanity.

name: Gore Magala Wing
desc:
A writhing, jet black flight
organ almost too hideous to
be called a "wing."

name: Gore Magala Wing+
desc:
A horrifying wing that casts
a hungry shadow over prey
and drives them insane.

name: Gore Magala Eclipse
desc:
Calamitous wings that go
unseen in the night, sowing
disease and reaping death.

name: Antinomic Wing
desc:
A strange harmony between
darkness and rainbow light
peeking between the bones.

name: Gore Magala Ripclaw
desc:
A menacing claw that carves
beautiful, indelible curves
through soft, pink flesh.

name: Gore Magala Ripclaw+
desc:
A claw from a third foreleg
that inflicts Frenzy and
generations of suffering.

name: Gore Magala Shredder
desc:
A grotesque claw that
sows madness. Some Smithies
shun it, fearing infection.

name: Gore Magala Tail
desc:
A pliant tail covered in
reverse scales that strikes
like a whip, not a blade.

name: Gore Magala Lash
desc:
A black tail covered in
sharp inverted scales that
shred prey at a stroke.

name: Gore Magala Plate
desc:
Plating from the wing-limbs
of the Gore Magala. Hunger
and madness deepen the hue.

name: Contrary Scale
desc:
A scale with a mix of white
and black that seem to be
trying to devour each other.

name: Gore Magala Nyctgem
desc:
A pure, dark jewel that
imprisons and then destroys
all nearby light.

name: Gore Magala Mantle
desc:
A scale considered unfind-
able. Equipment made with it
yields superhuman power.

name: Gore Magala Feeler
desc:
The Gore Magala's versatile
sensory organ and lifeline.
It serves many purposes.

name: Gore Magala Feeler+
desc:
A well-honed sensory organ
that oozes violet melancholy
from its infected tip.

name: Gore Magala Sensor
desc:
A large horn that pulses
purple -- an ill omen that
made this a forbidden spoil.

name: Diametrical Horn
desc:
A sensory organ full of
golden fibers that squeaks
eerily as it hardens.

name: Defiled Scale
desc:
A Frenzy-infested scale with
patches of sickly color that
make for a dangerous weapon.

name: Chaos Scale
desc:
A shape-shifting scale whose
jet-black cornified layer
has turned a golden white.

name: Hyper G.Magala Scale
desc:
Darker than normal Gore
Magala scales, this Hyper
scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper G.Magala Scale X
desc:
Darker than normal Gore Magala
scales, this Hyper scale emits
a steady, ominous glow.

name: S.Magala Scale
desc:
A shining scale just shy of
blinding white. Dignified,
like an ancient dragon.

name: S.Magala Scale+
desc:
A golden-white scale whose
light stays with the eye
through a thousand nights.

name: S.Magala Shard
desc:
An especially thick, white
scale. Fully matured, it
boasts wall-like resistance.

name: S.Magala Shell
desc:
A layered shell from which
scratches seem to disappear
before one's very eyes.

name: S.Magala Carapace
desc:
Celestial armor the Shagaru
Magala once wore: an
impervious font of light.

name: S.Magala Cortex
desc:
Impregnable armor. It is
said humankind possesses no
means of breaching it.

name: S.Magala Prismwing
desc:
A newly grown wing whose
seemingly airy membranes
belie rock-like strength.

name: S.Magala Prismwing+
desc:
A wing that casts iridescent
light in the sun. Thinner
wings sell at higher prices.

name: S.Magala Lightwing
desc:
A divine wing that guides
the living toward both
prosperity and ruin.

name: S.Magala Caress
desc:
A claw with a mystic shimmer
that hardens with age. Used
like a tree's growth rings.

name: S.Magala Caress+
desc:
A tender claw that hardens
only in the face of danger,
then kills softly.

name: S.Magala Purifier
desc:
A Shagaru Magala claw in its
hardest form. Proof of the
beast's death and rebirth.

name: S.Magala Tail
desc:
A white tail whose sheer
muscularity is concealed by
a coat of bristly scales.

name: S.Magala Lash
desc:
A strong tail with inverted
scales. Its pure white color
is proof of its fine quality.

name: S.Magala Plate
desc:
A back scale claimed only by
hunters who stand beneath
the beast's wings and survive.

name: S.Magala Phosgem
desc:
A pure jewel of light that
ignites the skies and
eradicates all darkness.

name: S.Magala Mantle
desc:
A white scale believed lost.
It can be used to create
gear with superhuman power.

name: S.Magala Horn
desc:
A hardened sensory organ.
The Frenzy's madness is
still locked inside.

name: S.Magala Horn+
desc:
A heroic arch whose hues
have been changed; even
now the Frenzy pollutes it.

name: S.Magala Hardhorn
desc:
A Shagaru Magala horn. These
are said to withstand the test
of time and never decay.

name: Pure Scale
desc:
A scale of forbidden white
whose complete lack of
impurities is truly rare.

name: Rajang Horn+
desc:
The majestic golden horn of
a Rajang. Hunters yearn for
the heroism it represents.

name: Rajang Hardhorn
desc:
A large, majestic golden horn.
All who see it feel the over-
whelming bravery of its owner.

name: Rajang Fang+
desc:
This sharpened fang can
cut through anything dumb
enough to touch it.

name: Rajang Hardfang
desc:
A Rajang fang that cuts through
anything. A prey's life vanishes
in an instant once caught.

name: Rajang Blackfur
desc:
Black Rajang fur. When
crafted, the resulting fabric
is desired even by royalty.

name: Rajang Wildpelt
desc:
A wild set of fur from a Rajang.
When forged, the jet-black fur
causes the wearer to rage.

name: Rajang Claw+
desc:
A sharp Rajang claw.
Difficult to carve and
more difficult to craft.

name: Rajang Hardclaw
desc:
A hard Rajang claw that's taken
a multitude of lives in a manner
best left unsaid.

name: Rajang Tail
desc:
The glistening tail of a
Rajang. The golden fur is
beautiful and elegant.

name: Gold Rajang Pelt
desc:
Fur taken from a Rajang's
body. The golden hair is
treasured by tailors.

name: Gold Rajang Pelt+
desc:
A golden pelt that shimmers
with the same furious power
as a Rajang.

name: Rajang Ragehair
desc:
Hair that hardens when a
Rajang becomes furious.
Armorsmiths line up for it.

name: Rajang Apoplexy
desc:
A long mane which still
bristles with rage. The
hairs are fine, but robust.

name: Rajang Nerve
desc:
The source of a Rajang's
power, which continues its
mystic pulsing after death.

name: Rajang Heart
desc:
A symbol of flesh-searing
rage that releases massive
power with every beat.

name: Ghoulish Gold Horn
desc:
The golden horn of a furious
Rajang. It seems almost too
lovely to waste on equipment.

name: Ghoulish Gold Gorer
desc:
A golden horn that seethes
with rage even now. Not to
be touched with bare hands.

name: Hyper Rajang Fur
desc:
Darker than normal Rajang
fur, this Hyper scale emits
an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Rajang Fur X
desc:
Darker than normal Rajang
fur, this Hyper fur emits
a steady, ominous glow.

name: Deviljho Scale
desc:
A greenish-black Deviljho scale.
It's not often sold, as rumors
claim it brings misfortune.

name: Deviljho Shard
desc:
A heavy, high-quality Deviljho
scale. Rumored to be bad luck,
but is excellent material.

name: Deviljho Crook
desc:
An unsettling scale that became
warped as it absorbed the hate
of the Deviljho's various prey.

name: Deviljho Hide
desc:
Black hide that is oddly
slimy and difficult to
forge with.

name: Deviljho Blackpiel
desc:
Thick hide taken from a violent
Deviljho. Especially slimy and
difficult to forge with.

name: Bloodied Ebonhide
desc:
A hide bloodied and battered
from ceaseless hunts that
give it no time to dry.

name: Deviljho Tallfang
desc:
A large fang from a maw
of alarming size. Helps the
vile beast sate its hunger.

name: Deviljho Hardfang
desc:
A massive fang that tears,
crushes, and grinds prey
without mercy.

name: Vile Fang
desc:
A massive, overgrown fang that
can chomp through anything.
Filled with pure evil.

name: Deviljho Talon
desc:
A dangerously sharp, hooked
talon. Inexperienced crafters
risk serious injury.

name: Deviljho Ripper
desc:
An incredibly sharp, rigid talon.
Even experienced handlers
can be injured if not careful.

name: Deviljho Scalp
desc:
Removing this part of a
Deviljho's skull releases an
unimaginably putrid odor.

name: Deviljho Tail
desc:
A massive tail resembling a
giant leech. Some folks are out
to collect these exclusively.

name: Deviljho Flail
desc:
A large slab of a Deviljho's
leech-like tail. Even so-called
experts are shocked by it.

name: Deviljho Saliva
desc:
The symbol of a Deviljho's
insatiable appetite. The strong
acid corrodes all it touches.

name: Black Blood
desc:
Dark black blood characteristic
of a Deviljho. It feels like it may
jump up and attack at any time.

name: Spattered Hide
desc:
A jet black hide with a
slimy, tar-like sheen: dried
blood spatter, some insist.

name: Deviljho Gem
desc:
A precious gem said to
contain a Deviljho's might.
Used in shady rituals.

name: Hyper Deviljho Scale
desc:
Darker than normal Deviljho
scales, this Hyper scale
emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Deviljho Scale X
desc:
Darker than normal Deviljho
scales, this Hyper scale
emits a steady, ominous glow.

name: Kirin Thunderhorn
desc:
The horn of Kirin, as
powerful as a lightning
bolt. Exquisite material.

name: Kirin Hide
desc:
A rare and lovely hide, but
difficult to carve loose and
dangerous to handle.

name: Kirin Hide+
desc:
A rare and lovely hide. This
one is undamaged: proof of
its former owner's strength.

name: Kirin Finehide
desc:
Beautiful Kirin hide that
hunters can only fantasize
of obtaining.

name: Kirin Mane
desc:
A rare, dashing mane that
retains its dignity even
after being cut free.

name: Platinum Mane
desc:
Kirin mane that sparkles like
platinum. It shimmers when
kissed by the wind. Priceless.

name: Kirin Thundertail
desc:
A rare tail, overflowing
with elegance, charged
with electricity.

name: Kirin Thunderlash
desc:
The highly rare tail of Kirin.
The electricity stored within
causes it to glimmer.

name: Kirin Azure Horn
desc:
An azure horn, rare
even among Kirin Horns.
Gives off a divine light.

name: Kirin Azure Peak
desc:
A dangerous horn containing
the charge of the thousand
bolts that struck it.

name: Daora Shell
desc:
The shining silver Kushala
Daora shell is solid and
highly useful.

name: Daora Carapace
desc:
A shell hardened by time.
Crafting it is incredibly
difficult.

name: Daora Cortex
desc:
The repeated molting of skin
has made this shell near
impregnable.

name: Daora Scale
desc:
A scale that glows a dull
silver. Hard enough to serve
as an abrasive for weapons.

name: Daora Dragon Scale+
desc:
High-quality scale from
Kushala Daora. It is said
to surpass steel.

name: Daora Shard
desc:
A thick scale from Kushala
Daora. The winters have made
it strong and cold to the touch.

name: Daora Webbing
desc:
Hard to craft but highly
compatible with metals.
Valued for its light weight.

name: Daora Fellwing
desc:
A curious wing that's strong as
steel, but soft to the touch.
Highly sought after material.

name: Daora Horn
desc:
The gallant horn of Daora.
Using it requires extra-
ordinary experience.

name: Daora Hardhorn
desc:
A hard, ferocious horn that
engulfs everything in a
freezing wind on impact.

name: Daora Horn+
desc:
A fierce-looking horn that
instantly robs the body of
cold if handled improperly.

name: Daora Tail
desc:
Cut from Kushala Daora.
Incredibly destructive
power contained within.

name: Daora Lash
desc:
The durable tail of Kushala
Daora. As strong as any storm,
but flexible as well.

name: Daora Claw
desc:
Kushala Daora's claw. As
hard as ore, it cannot be
used by ordinary crafters.

name: Daora Claw+
desc:
Even now the black gleam
of this claw seems to emit
a life force.

name: Daora Hardclaw
desc:
A robust claw one might
mistake for steel. Enhances
equipment capabilities.

name: Daora Gem
desc:
A rare gem formed inside a
Daora. Its glow is breathtaking.

name: Lrg Elder Dragon Gem
desc:
A giant, ultra-rare stone that
forms inside an Elder Dragon
once in a millennium.

name: Chameleos Hide
desc:
This hide is so strange to
the touch, you'll want to
rub it all over your face.

name: Chameleos Hide+
desc:
Superior hide of Chameleos.
Strange to the touch, but
very durable.

name: Chameleos Finehide
desc:
Top-grade Chameleos hide.
Its strange texture calms the
soul of those who touch it.

name: Chameleos Horn
desc:
Faintly glows with a
white light. Great for
interior decorating.

name: Chameleos Spike
desc:
A sharp horn of a Chameleos.
Strong and hard, but
strangely easy to work with.

name: Chameleos Hardhorn
desc:
A super-hard horn that
refracts light. A highly
sought commodity.

name: Chameleos Claw
desc:
Thin, yet incredibly
strong and very easy to
work with during crafting.

name: Chameleos Claw+
desc:
Sharpened claw of a Chameleos.
Small and sharp, but still valued
for being easy to work with.

name: Chameleos Hardclaw
desc:
A tough Chameleos claw. Its
slender sharpness and strength
make it an exceptional weapon.

name: Chameleos Webbing
desc:
Thin, light wing webbing.
The inner part of the
webbing is highly durable.

name: Chameleos Fellwing
desc:
A top-grade Chameleos wing.
The strong, firm frame makes
it invaluable as material.

name: Chameleos Tail
desc:
The distinctive tail of
Chameleos. Feels very
strange.

name: Chameleos Lash
desc:
The tough, hard tail of
Chameleos. The unique texture
makes for excellent material.

name: Chameleos Gem
desc:
A rare gem formed inside
Chameleos. It has a
multi-colored glow.

name: Teostra Shell
desc:
The red hot shell of
Teostra. It proves its
domain over all fire.

name: Teostra Carapace
Teostra Cortex
desc:
Merely looking upon this heavy
shell is enough to shatter the
hearts of hardened warriors.

name: Teostra Mane
desc:
This majestic mane is a
sure sign of Teostra's
regality.

name: Teostra Tail
desc:
Covered in red scales, the
tree like tail of Teostra
is incredibly hard to cut.

name: Teostra Lash
desc:
The stone-hard tail of Teostra.
A lash from this tail unleashes
unimaginable explosions.

name: Teostra Horn
desc:
A horn that displays the
power of Teostra. Hunters
wither before its might.

name: Teostra Horn+
desc:
A sharp horn that burns
with the fury of Teostra.
It is tinged with fire.

name: Teostra Hardhorn
desc:
A majestic horn that commands
all who gaze upon it to bend
the knee.

name: Fire Dragon Scale
desc:
A scalding hot scale. It'll
take your fingerprints
right off.
