name: Fire Dragon Scale+
desc:
A scale from a majestic
fire dragon. It burns with
hot fire from within.

name: Flame Shard
desc:
The highest quality scale from
Teostra. Hunters can only
dream of finding one.

name: Fire Dragon Claw
desc:
A sharp, glowing Fire
Dragon claw. Hard even for
experts to craft.

name: Teostra Claw+
desc:
A death sentence to he who
tries to elude the dragon's
flames. Still feels hot.

name: Fire Dragon Hardclaw
desc:
A hard, fiery Teostra claw.
It causes anything it scratches
to burst into flames.

name: Teostra Webbing
desc:
Wing webbing carved from a
fire dragon. A marvelous
material with many uses.

name: Teostra Powder
desc:
Powder from fire dragon
wings. Said to magnify a
material's abilities.

name: Teostra Gem
desc:
A rare gem formed inside
a fire dragon. Flickers with
ferocious flames.

name: Wyvern Crystal
desc:
A mysterious crystal that
glows with the energy of
both light and dark spirits.

name: Great Wyvern Crystal
desc:
A mysterious crystal of light and
dark spirits. The owner is said to
gain godlike powers.

name: Akantor Scale+
desc:
Faintly glittering Akantor
Scale. It will not melt,
even if dipped in lava.

name: Akantor Shard
desc:
A splendid scale with a
faint glow. Requires cooling
after all that time in lava.

name: Akantor Carapace
desc:
Shining Akantor Shell.
Exceptionally hard, and
thus difficult to craft.

name: Akantor Cortex
desc:
Bulky plating with a faint
glow. Deters most attacks
and repels the rest.

name: Akantor Tail
desc:
The large rock-like tail
of an Akantor. Strong
enough to gouge the earth.

name: Akantor Flail
desc:
A barbed tail that razes the
earth and knocks the fight
right out of prey.

name: Akantor Hardclaw
desc:
Hard Akantor claw that can
smash bedrock. Its victims
are left unrecognizable.

name: Akantor Shredtalon
desc:
An earth-shredding claw that
destroys anything caught in
the Akantor's charge.

name: Akantor Tallfang
desc:
Huge fang that can pierce
the heavens. It has passed
through many foes.

name: Akantor Greatfang
desc:
One of a pair of towering
fangs. The hard base makes
it ideal equipment material.

name: Akantor Spike
desc:
A flawless spike from
an Akantor. It can
easily scar rock.

name: Akantor Thickspike
desc:
A thick, sturdy shell spike
believed to have evolved as
defense against larger foes.

name: Akantor Gem
desc:
A gem that once belonged to
the Ancient World-King. Its
aura resists new ownership.

name: Conquest Sphere
desc:
A gem said to grant dominion
over everything under the
sun. Courses with ambition.

name: Ukanlos Carapace
desc:
The minerals encrusted in
this cold-infused shell
make it surprisingly strong.

name: Ukanlos Cortex
desc:
The minerals encrusted in
this cold-infused cortex
make it surprisingly strong.

name: Ukanlos Underscale
desc:
A thick, sharp belly scale.
Cuts through snow, allowing
Ukanlos to move easier.

name: Ukanlos Underscale+
desc:
A thick, sharp belly scale.
Used to get around by
cutting through the ice.

name: Ukanlos Tail
desc:
The icy tail of Ukanlos.
A single lash makes the air
scream and the earth cry.

name: Ukanlos Flail
desc:
A giant, icy Ukanlos tail.
One swipe makes the air
scream and glaciers crack.

name: Ukanlos Digger
desc:
An Ukanlos claw. Repeated
voyages through the ice have
twisted its shape.

name: Ukanlos Digger+
desc:
An impossibly massive claw
with ridges used to pull the
monster onto the ice.

name: Ukanlos Shoveljaw
desc:
Ukanlos's shovel-like jaw.
Developed to shovel snow, one
scoop can cause an avalanche.

name: Ukanlos Shoveljaw+
desc:
A prominent jaw that makes
for a real spectacle when it
smashes apart hunks of ice.

name: Ukanlos Fin+
desc:
A huge dorsal fin with
saw-like ridges at the tip
that cut through anything.

name: Ukanlos Strongfin
desc:
A giant, saw-like fin that
runs along the Ukanlos's
back. Cuts through all.

name: Ukanlos Gem
desc:
A gem owned by a king who
nearly ended the world. It
seeks to destroy new owners.

name: Ukanlos Stone
desc:
A legendary Ukanlos stone.
Those who craft it rule the
earth and seize the sky.

name: Alatreon Scute
desc:
A unique plating that can
protect against attacks, and
even deflect blows.

name: Alatreon Pallium
desc:
A miraculous plate impervious to
all attacks. Legend says the
bearer receives heaven's love.

name: Alatreon Plate
desc:
This particular Alatreon
scale grows in backwards.
It is as sharp as a blade.

name: Alatreon Mantle
desc:
The mantle of Alatreon is
the stuff of legend, containing
traces of every element within.

name: Alatreon Talon
desc:
A talon capable of making
weapons of untold power.
Ridiculously sharp.

name: Alatreon Riptalon
desc:
The mere sight of this deadly
talon calls forth images of
terrible weapons made from it.

name: Alatreon Webbing
desc:
At times this looks like a
dark abyss; at others, like
the coming of first light.

name: Alatreo Direwing
desc:
This vile wing can cut through
time and space to destroy the
entire world...say the rumors.

name: Alatreon Tail
desc:
The tail from an Alatreon,
previously thought to only
have existed in legend.

name: Alatreo Diretail
desc:
"Is this a dream?" "Am I alive?"
Those who grasp this tail begin
to harbor such doubts.

name: Broken Skypiercer
desc:
A piece of the horn from atop
an Alatreon's head. Broken due
to the difficulty harvesting it.

name: Skypiercer
desc:
Part of an Alatreon's
convoluted horns.

name: Skyswayer
desc:
Part of an Alatreon's
convoluted horns. The finest
specimen known to exist.

name: Azure Dragongem
desc:
The legend to beat all legends.
It is said to bring about the
end of those who obtain it.

name: Azure Dragonsphire
desc:
Legend says the discovery of
this brilliant gem heralds
the end of the world.

name: Amatsu Carapace
desc:
Black armor beaten by
fierce winds into powerful
defense for a celestial god.

name: Amatsu Cortex
desc:
This black armor, forged by the
storm for a malevolent god, is
almost unmatched in strength.

name: Amatsu Webbing
desc:
Ethereal robes that make
one appear to float, like
something out of a fable.

name: Amatsu Membrane
desc:
Legendary material that, when
worn, can even allow the wearer
to float for a short time.

name: Amatsu Horn
desc:
A horn carved from an Amatsu.
The unblemished horns are
proof of its strength.

name: Amatsu Hardhorn
desc:
A horn carved from an Amatsu.
It was grown in the midst of
ferocious storms.

name: Amatsu Claw+
desc:
The incredibly sharp claw of an
Amatsu. Just seeing the claw
will instill fear of its owner.

name: Amatsu Hardclaw
desc:
The incredibly sharp claw of an
Amatsu. Just seeing the claw
inspires intense fear.

name: Amatsu Tail
desc:
The tail of the Storm Dragon.
It is very tough, which helps
maneuverability in the storm.

name: Amatsu Stormtail
desc:
The gorgeous tail of the Storm
Dragon. Its dancing movements
are said to call the storm.

name: Amatsu Pleura
desc:
A chestplate that is said to
steal the future of those who
bathe in its passionate light.

name: Amatsu Heavypleura
desc:
A heavy chestplate whose light
emits despair. The passion it
inspires is particularly strong.

name: Storm Vesicle
desc:
Unique organ that stores large
amounts of water. Even a
sliver can power up your gear.

name: Storm Vesicle Clump
desc:
A particularly well-developed
organ that stores enough water
to wash away the world.

name: Heavenly Dragongem
desc:
The root of the celestial
gods' power. It grants their
far-reaching vision.

name: Heavenly Dragonsphire
desc:
The root of the celestial
gods' power. It grants their
far-reaching vision.

name: Dragon Healing Crystal
desc:
A hard crystal made from dragon
scales. Valued as medicine.
<COL FFFF50FF>(Account Item)</COL>

name: Lao-Shan Shard
desc:
The thick scale of Lao-Shan.
Its hardness is on par with any
wyvern cortex.

name: Lao-Shan Cortex
desc:
An unbelievably heavy shell
from Lao-Shan. The ages have
made this shell immortal.

name: Lao-Shan Hardhorn
desc:
Horn from a Lao-Shan Lung snout.
Perfectly formed even without
forging -- a true luxury item.

name: Lao-Shan Megaclaw
desc:
A Lao-Shan Lung claw. So gigantic
that even skilled artisans find
themselves unable to work it.

name: Lao-Shan Mantle
desc:
A legendary scale of Lao-Shan.
Those who craft it rule the
earth and seize the sky.

name: Fatalis Shard
desc:
A thick, jet-black scale that
covers the body of Fatalis.
Grows thick with age.

name: Fatalis Cortex
desc:
Harder than a Fatalis shell,
it's also known as Mediastinum.

name: Fatalis Hardhorn
desc:
A horn of immense strength.
The black glow of the horn
gives off a strange attraction.

name: Fatalis Evil Eye
desc:
An unusual aura surrounds the
eye of Fatalis. Perhaps it's
possessed...

name: Fatalis Fellwing
desc:
A wing hard as any metal, yet
still very malleable. Only the
most skilled can work with it.

name: Crimson Fatalis Scale
desc:
The scale of a Fatalis
overcome with rage. Crimson
fire hides a deep darkness.

name: Crimson Fatalis Shell
desc:
The shell of a Fatalis
overcome with rage. It shines
an unforgiving crimson.

name: Crimson Fatalis Horn
desc:
The horn of a Fatalis
overcome with rage. It looks
ready to tear down the sky.

name: Crimson Fatalis Wing
desc:
The wing of a Fatalis
overcome with rage. The air
fears its crimson pulse.

name: Fatalis Devileye+
desc:
The eye of a Fatalis
overcome with rage. Its wicked
gaze devours one's courage.

name: Old Fatalis Shard
desc:
A sparkling white scale of an
ancient Fatalis. Its beauty can
capture your heart.

name: Old Fatalis Cortex
desc:
A sparkling white shell of an
ancient Fatalis. Heavier and
stronger than most parts.

name: Old Fatalis Hardhorn
desc:
A sparkling white horn of an
ancient Fatalis. Said to be
lightning personified.

name: Old Fatalis Fellwing
desc:
A sparkling white wing of an
ancient Fatalis. To gaze upon
it is to know true oppression.

name: Old Fatalis Souleye
desc:
A crimson eye, fierce and
unforgiving, that gazes back
with red, electric finality.

name: Nakarkos Husk
desc:
The outer shell covering the
Nakarkos. Used for crafting,
but not much else is known.

name: Nakarkos Husk+
desc:
Bones that have become
hardened somehow due to
the fluid of a Nakarkos.

name: Heavy Nakarkos Husk
desc:
These bones have become
impossibly hard after years of
soaking in Nakarkos fluid.

name: Nakarkos Shell
desc:
The outer shell covering the
Nakarkos. Its properties make
for great armor.

name: Nakarkos Shell+
desc:
A spiny outer shell, it has
undergone many changes over
time, making it quite unique.

name: Nakarkos Hardshell
desc:
The outer shell covering the
Nakarkos. Its hardness makes
truly top-class armor.

name: Nakarkos Skull
desc:
A horrifying skull that
strikes fear into the hearts
of all who see it.

name: Nakarkos Hardskull
desc:
A hair-raisingly frightening skull.
Said to induce fainting in those
who gaze upon its horror.

name: Nakarkos Vertebra
desc:
The sound of this bone terrifies
all who hear it. Surprisingly
easy to work with.

name: Nakarkos Hardvertebra
desc:
The echoing sound of this bone
brings madness to all who hear it.
Valuable and easy to work with.

name: Nakarkos Hide
desc:
The beautiful blue hide of a
Nakarkos. It is hard to tear
despite its elasticity.

name: Nakarkos Azurehide
desc:
The beautiful blue hide of a
Nakarkos. Both incredibly strong
and highly-prized.

name: Nakarkos Arm Brace
desc:
A keratinized brace from the
oral arm of a Nakarkos. Hard
and oozing a strong adhesive.

name: Scary Nakarkos ArmBrce
desc:
A keratinized brace from the
oral arm of a Nakarkos. Stickier
and harder than ever.

name: Nakarkos Fang
desc:
One of countless fangs in
the mouth of a Nakarkos. It can
crunch through bone with ease.

name: Nakarkos Cuttlebone
desc:
A small white bone that is
found inside the body of a
Nakarkos.

name: Lrg Nakarkos Cuttlebone
desc:
A huge white bone found inside
the body of a Nakarkos. Though
called a bone, it's more of a shell.

name: Nakarkos Soul Orb
desc:
A jewel formed in a Nakarkos
from the remains of the
endless prey it has devoured.

name: Nakarkos SecretSoulOrb
desc:
An extremely rare jewel formed
inside a Narkakos from the
remains of its prey.

name: Radiant Mucus
desc:
A viscous liquid produced by
the Nakarkos. It gives off
an ominous glow.

name: Radiant Mucus+
desc:
Nakarkos mucus is said to
help prevent the deterioration
of bone materials.

name: Viscous Radiant Mucus
desc:
Good quality Narkakos mucus.
Keeps bone in good condition
and can harden it too.

name: Valstrax Scale+
desc:
A high-quality Valstrax scale that
can withstand movement at the
speed of sound.

name: Valstrax Shard
desc:
A faintly glittering silver Valstrax
scale. Precious dragon scales like
these were once used in rituals.

name: Valstrax Carapace
desc:
A sturdy Valstrax outer shell. Not
even impacts at the speed of
sound can mar it.

name: Valstrax Cortex
desc:
A particularly hard shell inside
Valstrax's outer shell. Light and
strong, it's of the finest quality.

name: Valstrax Claw+
desc:
This piece of Valstrax claw is
remarkably hard and sharp. It's
torn up countless peacetimes.

name: Valstrax Hardclaw
desc:
A fierce-looking Valstrax claw.
Just the sight of this disaster-
bringing claw chills the blood.

name: Valstrax Tail
desc:
A large Valstrax tail that shines
like a comet. Effortlessly sweeps
aside all tranquility.

name: Valstrax Helixtail
desc:
A beautifully sharp section of
Valstrax tail. Glows eerily like
the tail of a comet.

name: Valstrax Lancewing
desc:
A Valstrax wing, capable of
infinite subtle variety. Requires
special handling to work with.

name: Valstrax Lancewing+
desc:
A rare piece of Valstrax wing,
the pointed tip changes shape
and is used to attack prey.

name: Valstrax Spineshell
desc:
A Valstrax shell used to protect
its back. Its sharp, glittering points
look like sharpened blades.

name: Valstrax Spineshell+
desc:
A very rare piece of spine-
protecting Valstrax shell that
gleams like a giant mirror.

name: Red Dragon Mindstone
desc:
The source of evil heavenly
omens. The owner gains the
power of the red comet.

name: Ruby Dragon Mindstone
desc:
The source of evil heavenly
omens. The owner gains the
power to bring disaster.

name: Burned Husk
desc:
An object that dropped from a
comet, of great interest to the
Wycademy researchers.

name: Shimmering Dragonfluid
desc:
The red light this Valstrax
fluid emits is always
slightly warm.

name: Golden Silk
desc:
Golden thread left behind by an
Ahtal-Ka. Its tensile strength and
great beauty give it value.

name: Ahtal-Ka Gold Cocoon
desc:
A shimmering golden Ahtal-Ka
shell. Its ancient surface is filled
with mysterious beauty.

name: Ahtal-Ka Purple Cocoon
desc:
A purple piece of Ahtal-Ka shell.
Worth much more than the
ordinary shells.

name: Ahtal-Ka Foreblade
desc:
A piece of sharp Ahtal-Ka
foreleg. Note its fantastic cutting
ability and attractive glitter.

name: Iridescent Carapace
desc:
A piece of Ahtal-Ka shell. Its
color changes depending on
the angle of the light.

name: Ahtal-Ka Pheromone
desc:
A fragrant liquid secreted by an
Ahtal-Ka. Its scent is so strong it
can be detected for miles.

name: Ahtal-Ka Fine Silk
desc:
A bright thread spun by an
Ahtal-Ka. Contains beautiful
crystalline patterns.

name: Ahtal-Ka Alluring Gem
desc:
A jewel that will bewitch a
beholder forever. Created after
an eternity deep in the ruins.

name: Royal Pyroxene
desc:
The pyroxene throne created such
fear among the people that they
could only kneel before it.

name: Map
desc:
A complete field map that
shows terrain.
<COL FFFF50FF>(Supply Item)</COL>

name: First-aid Med
desc:
Restores a small amount of
Health.
<COL FFFF50FF>(Supply Item)</COL>

name: First-aid Med+
desc:
Restores a moderate amount
of Health.
<COL FFFF50FF>(Supply Item)</COL>

name: Ration
desc:
Restores a small amount of
Stamina.
<COL FFFF50FF>(Supply Item)</COL>

name: Portable Spit
desc:
A portable spit issued to
new hunters. Get cookin'!
<COL FFFF50FF>(Supply Item)</COL>

name: Mini Whetstone
desc:
A portable Whetstone for
restoring Sharpness to weapons.
<COL FFFF50FF>(Supply Item)</COL>

name: EZ Shock Trap
desc:
Immobilizes a target for
easy capture.
<COL FFFF50FF>(Supply Item)</COL>

name: EZ Flash Bomb
desc:
A grenade-like bomb that
flashes brightly on impact.
<COL FFFF50FF>(Supply Item)</COL>

name: EZ Sonic Bomb
desc:
A grenade-like bomb that emits
a loud, high-frequency sound.
<COL FFFF50FF>(Supply Item)</COL>

name: EZ Max Potion
desc:
Fully restores Health and
maximizes your Health Gauge.
<COL FFFF50FF>(Supply Item)</COL>

name: EZ Lifepowder
desc:
Heals those within range
with a single touch.
<COL FFFF50FF>(Supply Item)</COL>

name: EZ Dust of Life
desc:
Disperses on use and heals
serious injuries instantly.
<COL FFFF50FF>(Supply Item)</COL>

name: EZ Pitfall Trap
desc:
Activates a pitfall to catch
monsters with.
<COL FFFF50FF>(Supply Item)</COL>

name: EZ Barrel Bomb L
desc:
A powered-up Barrel Bomb L.
Just as potent as a Barrel
Bomb L+. <COL FFFF50FF>(Supply Item)</COL>

name: EZ Hunter's Drink
desc:
Temporarily makes it easier to
refill the Hunter Arts Gauge.
<COL FFFF50FF>(Supply Item)</COL>

name: Ballista Ammo
desc:
Ammunition for the large
Ballista.
<COL FFFF50FF>(Supply Item)</COL>

name: One-shot Binder
desc:
Ballista ammo that restrains
targets. Disposable ammo, no
cooldown. <COL FFFF50FF>(Supply Item)</COL>

name: Anti-dragon Bomb
desc:
A small time bomb that can
be stuck directly on targets
you mount. <COL FFFF50FF>(Supply Item)</COL>

name: Dense Marcoal
desc:
Special fuel used with the
Demolisher. Requires a cooldown
between uses. <COL FFFF50FF>(Supply Item)</COL>

name: Paw Pass Ticket
desc:
Deliver to end the Quest.
Maybe the Felynes will take
you home... <COL FFFF50FF>(Supply Item)</COL>

name: EZ Farcaster
desc:
Instantly transports you
back to base camp.
<COL FFFF50FF>(Supply Item)</COL>

name: Rusted Fragment
desc:
An oddly shaped metal fragment
covered in rust. It looks like it
could be used for something...

name: Ancient Fragment
desc:
A metal fragment taken from
deep in the earth. Still
strong, and maybe useful...

name: Mythical Fragment
desc:
An unidentifiably old piece of
metal that gives off a mystical
light. Might be usable somehow.

name: Sinister Cloth
desc:
Found long ago in the tomb
of a king from a long
forgotten desert land.

name: Sinister Darkcloth
desc:
A burial cloth said to have been
used on the ancient king in the
desert. Believed to be cursed.

name: Sinister Gloomcloth
desc:
A cloth worn by a messenger of
a far away, long ago underworld.
Can supposedly absorb life.

name: Extravagant Artifact
desc:
Either the burial item of an
ancient dynasty, or a cache of
pirate treasure. How exciting!

name: Opulent Artifact
desc:
Some people spend their
entire lives looking for this
kind of haul.

name: Decadent Artifact
desc:
To gaze upon this dazzling
ornament is to gaze upon a star,
and have your heart stolen away.

name: Broken Statue
desc:
An ancient-looking statue.
Bears no hints as to when and
why it was made, or by whom.

name: Large Broken Statue
desc:
A massive statue left from an
epic time. Has been exposed
to the elements for eons.

name: Broken Cat God Statue
desc:
A solemn stone cat statue,
redolent of history's riddles. A
god messenger, or religious icon?

name: Dark Piece
desc:
A mysterious, ominous piece
of Dark Stone. Crafting it
is a scary proposition.

name: Dark Stone
desc:
A jet-black stone with an
ominous aura. Holding it
wraps one in despair.

name: Felyne Kettle
desc:
A kettle the Felyne have poured
their sheer joy into. Don't forget
to remove it from the heat!

name: Yukumo Riceflour
desc:
An ingredient for making sweets.
However, it can become quite
hard if prepared incorrectly.

name: Doll Parts
desc:
It is usually given as a gift to
small children. However, if you
give it to an artisan...

name: Weapon Codex
desc:
A secret text that describes
the crafting process for a
weapon from a far-off land.

name: Bowgun Codex
desc:
A secret text that describes
the crafting process for a
Bowgun from a far-off land.

name: Deluxe Barrel Timber
desc:
Unique wood that won't break
even when bent, so the barrels it
makes can be used as armor.

name: Ancient Talisman
desc:
A talisman enshrining the holiness
of an eastern god. The Smithy
might give you new insight...

name: Damaged Amber
desc:
This strange amber is the subject
of ongoing research. It could be
used in crafting.

name: Cloudy Fragment
desc:
This scale mingles white and
black, and gives off an ominous
aura. Can be used in crafting.

name: Strange Mask
desc:
Cha-Cha and Kayamba's
strongest mask...is not this one.
Can be used in crafting.

name: Sunmarge Crystal
desc:
A very rare crystal, seldom seen
for sale. Its fishlike form is
impressive.

name: Ocean Pyroxene
desc:
A jewel that gives off a limpid
blue glow. The whole ocean
seems to be contained within it.

name: Fluffy White Ball
desc:
A snow-white ball of fluffy
material. Can make a Palico
even cuter!

name: Fluffy Black Ball
desc:
A pitch-black ball of fluffy
material. Can make a Palico
even cuter!

name: Fusion Material - Head
desc:
Material used to combine the
form of one head armor
with the function of another.

name: Fusion Material - Chest
desc:
Material used to combine the
form of one chest armor
with the function of another.

name: Fusion Material - Arms
desc:
Material used to combine the
form of one set of armguards
with the function of another.

name: Fusion Material - Waist
desc:
Material used to combine the
form of one waist armor
with the function of another.

name: Fusion Material - Legs
desc:
Material used to combine the
form of one set of leg armor
with the function of another.

name: F Fusion Material - Head
desc:
Material used to combine the
form of one Palico head armor
with the function of another.

name: F Fusion Material - Chest
desc:
Material used to combine the
form of one Palico chest armor
with the function of another.

name: Voucher
desc:
Redeem this for a special
Meal with stronger effects
than usual.

name: Gourmet Voucher
desc:
Exchange this for a kingly
Meal. Both its flavor and
effects are top notch.

name: Commendation
desc:
A ticket awarded for a
display of bravery. Collect
enough and it might pay off.

name: Commendation G
desc:
A ticket awarded for
great bravery. Collect
enough and it might pay off.

name: Commendation XX
desc:
A ticket awarded for peerless
bravery. Collect enough and
it might pay off.

name: Accolade
desc:
A ticket awarded to one who
brings hope. Collect enough
and it might pay off.

name: Accolade G
desc:
A ticket awarded to one who
brings great hope. Collect
enough and it might pay off.

name: Accolade XX
desc:
A ticket awarded to one who
brings immense hope. Collect
enough and it might pay off.

name: Distinction
desc:
A ticket awarded to one adept
in Hunting Arts. Collect enough
and it might pay off.

name: Privilege
desc:
A ticket awarded to one who
has challenged G-rank Quests.
If you give it to the Smithy...

name: Privilege G
desc:
A ticket awarded to a warrior
who's challenged G-rank Quests.
If you give it to the Smithy...

name: Triumph
desc:
Evidence of one who has
overcome many trials. Gives
true honor to the holder.

name: Pawprint Stamp
desc:
Lynian paper currency, stamped
with a pawprint. The letters
written on it are unfamiliar.

name: Pawprint Ticket
desc:
A Lynian ticket decorated with
bright pawprint stamps. Received
in thanks for something.

name: Bherna Ticket
desc:
Received for contributions
to Bherna Village. If you
give it to the Smithy...

name: Bherna Ticket G
desc:
Received for great contributions
to Bherna Village. If you
give it to the Smithy...

name: Kokoto Ticket
desc:
Received for contributions
to Kokoto Village. If you
give it to the Smithy...

name: Kokoto Ticket G
desc:
Received for great contributions
to Kokoto Village. If you
give it to the Smithy...

name: Pokke Ticket
desc:
Received for contributions
to Pokke Village. If you
give it to the Smithy...

name: Pokke Ticket G
desc:
Received for great contributions
to Pokke Village. If you
give it to the Smithy...

name: Yukumo Ticket
desc:
Received for contributions
to Yukumo Village. If you
give it to the Smithy...

name: Yukumo Ticket G
desc:
Received for great contributions
to Yukumo Village. If you
give it to the Smithy...

name: Wycademy Ticket
desc:
Received for contributions
to the Wycademy. If you
give it to the Smithy...

name: Wycademy Ticket G
desc:

desc:
An apple popular amongst
Felyne connoisseurs. It is a
popular item to trade.

desc:
An apple highly sought after
by Felyne connoisseurs. It has
very high trade value.

name: Huge Lagniapple
desc:
An apple highly sought after
by Felyne connoisseurs. It has
extremely high trade value.

name: Training Guide
desc:
A manual detailing the exploits
of a veteran Felyne warrior. It
increases training effectiveness.

name: Training Codex
desc:
The memoirs of a Felyne that
fought many battles. It greatly
increases training effectiveness.

name: Training Compendium
desc:
The compiled wisdom of a Felyne
hero. It increases training
effectiveness immeasurably.

name: Felyne Codex
desc:
A collaboration between Palicoes
that helps change Support/Skills
to whatever you feel is useful.

name: Timeworn Ballista Shot
desc:
An old piece of ballista ammo
embedded in the bone of a
Nakarkos. <COL FFFF50FF>(Account Item)</COL>

name: Tomato Juice
desc:
Delicious and filled with nutrients,
this tomato juice is good to drink
for those who've lost a lot of blood.

name: Fairy Tail Mark
desc:
A Mage Guild mark from lands
far away. Proof of friendships
that stand the test of time.

name: F Pirate Coin J
desc:
Proof that you've completed a
JUMP Quest. It depicts the image
of a legendary Felyne pirate.

name: Cardboard
desc:
Simple cardboard material,
yet it has the odd effect of
sparking the imagination.

name: Uniqlo Coin
desc:
A Uniqlo coin designed
with both form and
function in mind.

name: Soulstone
desc:
A mysterious rock said to
house the soul of a monster.
This one contains Fire.

name: Crows Coin
desc:
A coin that proves one to be the
worst of the worst. The back side
has the names of noted thugs.

name: Bicycle Club Application
desc:
Proof that one has joined the
Bicycle Club. Keep pedaling
until you win Nationals!

name: Arena Ticket
desc:
A ticket for admission to an
underground arena where warriors
fight to see who's the strongest.

name: Grandpaw Coin
desc:
A coin from Grandpaw Danger, it
can be traded for Palico gear that
protects its wearer from danger.

name: CoroCoro Ticket
desc:
A ticket adorned with the
CoroCoro dragon, who brings
dreams to boys and girls.

name: Ushio Coin
desc:
An ancient-looking coin containing
a deep-seated grudge. It is used
for creating demon-slaying gear.

name: Magi Coin
desc:
A coin given to those Magi recognize
as worthy. It is used to create
weapons imbued with magical power.

name: Pluto Stardust
desc:
A shooting star fragment
used to create Shonen
Magazine's special gear.

name: Roll of Fate
desc:
A trump card that ensures a
duel's victory. A magician is
beautifully drawn on one side.

name: Pirate Ticket J
desc:
Proof that you've conquered
a JUMP Quest. It depicts a
captain and his beloved sword.

name: Famitsu Ticket
desc:
Authorizes you to produce a
special Famitsu weapon. The
word "gavas" is written on it.

name: Dengeki Ticket
desc:
Thanks for participating in
our event! Remember to pick
up Dengeki Game Magazine!

name: Uniqlo Coin S
desc:
A special Uniqlo coin designed
with both form and
function in mind.

name: Wind Waker
desc:
A conductor's baton with the
power to control the wind. Given
to a legendary hero's successor.

name: Arwing Boarding Pass
desc:
A boarding pass for a tour on
a starship. A weapon blueprint
is written on the back.

name: Super Mushroom
desc:
A red-capped mushroom
with white spots. One bite
makes you big and tough.

name: Design Pattern
desc:
Now you can be a fashion
leader just like Isabelle
and Mr. Resetti!

name: Triforce
desc:
Proof that the goddess saw
courage in the heart of a
young hero clad in green.

name: Samus Coin
desc:
An ancient coin given to the
protectors of the galaxy. A Chozo
emblem is carved on one side.

name: Goddess's Grace
desc:
The power of the Goddess
crystallized into a jewel.
Grants one eternal peace.

name: Goddess's Embrace
desc:
The power of the Goddess
crystallized into a crown.
Grants one eternal honor.

name: SF Coin
desc:
Given to martial artists who never
miss training, this coin is proof of
those seeking new challenges.

name: Red Orb
desc:
A magical red stone that contains
the blood of demons. It makes for
quite stylish Palico weapons.

name: Ceratanium
desc:
A strong, yet light alloy developed
by the father of robotics. It is the
material used by a special robot.

name: Hero's Seal
desc:
An item given to hunters who are
passionate about their craft. A
true symbol of the art of hunting.

name: Baby Journal
desc:
A journal charting the growth
of baby monsters. It includes
daily observations and thoughts.

name: Sunsnug Journal
desc:
A journal with cute illustrations
depicting the daily life of a Felyne
living in a Lynian village.

name: Fan Club Newsletter
desc:
A newsletter for all the
passionate fan club
members.

name: Fan Club Application
desc:
An application form to join the
only club for true MH-lovers!
Come join the fun!

name: Fan Club Invite
desc:
An invite to a fan club for
ardent monster hunters ONLY!
Welcome to the gang.

name: Puppet Ticket
desc:
A ticket stamped with the
paw prints of two Felynes.

name: Great Stone
desc:
This stone looks normal, but it has
an incredible sense of presence
and exudes an ancient feel.

name: Courier's Letter
desc:
Neither snow nor rain nor gloom
of night stays the Courier from
delivering people's dreams.

name: Kaioh Certificate
desc:
It says "Hunting is a
precious skill, a refinement
of the heart."

name: WORST Coin
desc:
A shabby coin, but proof
that you've gone toe to toe
with a real monster.

name: Evidence
desc:
Evidence left at the scene.
We can infer the appearance
of the perp via deduction!

name: Salaryman Coin
desc:
Swap for Palico hardware
to defend against enraged
bosses.

name: Taisha-ryu Codex
desc:
A swordfighting style
permitted only to those
who would die for honor.

name: Famitsu Coupon
desc:
A ticket awarded to skilled
hunters that lets you create
exclusive Famitsu weapons.

name: Dengeki Ticket XX
desc:
Thanks for taking part
in our event! We hope
to see you again soon!

name: Flying Xin Mark
desc:
Proof of membership in the
elite army unit of a man who
would be general.

name: Buccaneer Ticket J
desc:
Proof that you've conquered
a Jump Quest. It depicts a
captain and his sword.

name: Magic Realm Key
desc:
A key to unlock both realms
unknown and custom gear from
the Shonen Magazine Boss.

name: Zaruba Fragment
desc:
A piece of a magic ring that
exhausted its energy to save
its friends. It still glows.

name: Turnabout Ticket
desc:
A pass to a heated court
battle. Lets you make lawyer
gear at the Palico Armory.

name: Navirou Ticket
desc:
Lets you create gear
resembling a very unique,
enigmatic-looking Felyne.

name: F Spirit Stone
desc:
A monster's spirit seals
away the Felyne power in
this strange stone.

name: Club Promotion
desc:
Congrats! This proves that
you possess true skill. You
better not slack off again!

name: JDL Badge
desc:
Proves that you're a member
of the Junior Detective
League. One truth prevails!

name: Silver Crystal
desc:
A piece of a crystal filled
with the love of a princess
for her friends.

name: Zelda Ticket
desc:
A Triforce fragment proving
that your power has been
recognized by a goddess.

name: Zelda Ticket G
desc:
A Triforce fragment proving
that your courage has been
recognized by a goddess.

name: Sealing Shield
desc:
A shield with five shining orbs that
conceal a mysterious power, which is
said to protect the world from evil.

name: Option
desc:
A small robot that supports
Hiryu on his missions by firing
beams or blocking attacks.

name: Celestial Scroll
desc:
A beautifully drawn scroll
depicting Amaterasu, the Sun
Goddess, in all her divinity.

name: Arthur's Armor
desc:
Knight's armor for the brave
and valiant. Chivalrous straw-
berry-print boxers included.

name: Zelda Ticket P
desc:
A Triforce fragment proving
that your wisdom has been
recognized by a goddess.
